paper.title: Beyond Atomic Layouts: Compositional Design Understanding with Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Layout understanding, or the interpretation of element organization, is essential for document analysis, user interface (UI) creation, and graphic design. While recent vision-language models (VLMs) excel at interpreting atomic layouts composed of independent elements, they struggle with compositional layouts that require reasoning over visually entangled elements within hierarchical multi-layer structures. In this paper, we introduce a new task, compositional layout understanding, and present Co

summary.core_problem: 研究 VLM 是否能理解多层级、元素相互纠缠的组合式版面，而不只是识别彼此独立的简单布局元素。
summary.importance: 贡献包括一个新的组合式版面理解任务、约 20K 真实多层布局 VQA 数据集 CoDeLayout，以及面向该任务的后训练方案。对 VLM 视觉结构理解和图文对齐有参考意义，但场景偏 UI/设计版面，不是通用基座预训练核心问题。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先构造 CoDeLayout，标注组合元素对和设计意图，用来测试层级结构、元素关系和视觉-文本一致性。随后提出 MASON 后训练范式，结合 multimodal alignment 和 structural perception：前者缓解文本元数据与视觉内容的语义漂移，后者增强层级元素关系和结构歧义的建模。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 CoDeLayout 上对现有 VLM 做经验分析，发现它们在组合式版面上受语义漂移和结构歧义限制；同时评估 MASON 的改进效果。摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据量、baseline 名称或提升数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether VLMs can understand compositional, multi-layer layouts with visually entangled elements, rather than only atomic layouts made of independent elements.
summary_en.importance: It contributes a new compositional layout understanding task, a roughly 20K-example real-world VQA dataset named CoDeLayout, and a post-training method for the task. It is relevant to visual structure understanding and multimodal alignment, but the setting is still specialized around UI and graphic design layouts.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoDeLayout annotates real-world multi-layer layouts with compositional element pairs and design intent. The proposed MASON post-training paradigm combines multimodal alignment, which reduces semantic drift between textual metadata and visual content, with structural perception, which targets ambiguity in hierarchical inter-element relations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports empirical analysis of existing VLMs on CoDeLayout and identifies semantic drift and structural ambiguity as two key failure modes. MASON is evaluated as a post-training method, but the abstract does not provide concrete model sizes, baseline names, training data details, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 看任务定义和 failure taxonomy 就够；MASON 像常规后训练，真正可迁移的是结构歧义的测法。
recommendation.en: Read the task definition and failure taxonomy; MASON looks like routine post-training, while the transferable part is how they measure structural ambiguity.

paper.title: Alignment Is All You Need: Instruction-Free Training for General Audio-Language Models
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are typically built through a multi-stage pipeline consisting of cross-modal alignment, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and preference optimization. This pipeline assumes that adapting an LLM to a new modality requires extensive task-specific supervision. However, pretrained LLMs already possess strong reasoning and instruction-following abilities. As LLMs evolve rapidly, an important question remains: can we efficiently transfer these capabilities to a new

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是：把音频接到一个已经会遵循指令的 LLM 上，是否一定需要多阶段的音频指令 SFT 和偏好优化。论文的结论是，在冻结音频 encoder 和 LLM 的前提下，只训练一个轻量 projector，配合无指令的语义对齐数据，也可以得到有竞争力的通用 audio-language model。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发点在于，它把多模态适配中的“对齐”和“教任务”拆开了。LLM 的指令跟随能力来自文本预训练和 post-training，音频 encoder 的感知能力来自音频预训练；如果两者都足够强，新模态适配未必需要重新训练解码器。这个结果支持一种更模块化的多模态预训练接口：新模态先学会进入 LLM 的语义嵌入空间，而不是用大量任务模板重新塑形整个模型。贡献不是新的语言建模目标，但对 audio LM、VLM adapter 设计、pretrain 与 posttrain 接口都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三部分组成：冻结的音频 encoder、冻结的自回归 LLM、可训练 projector。音频 encoder 将原始音频编码成时间序列特征，projector 将这些特征映射到 LLM 的输入 embedding 空间，作为连续前缀供 LLM 解码。训练时不使用显式任务指令，也不构造人工 QA 模板。论文沿用并扩展 Shao et al. 的 Self-Generated Data Construction 思路：把音频 caption 当作语义代理，再用 LLM 将 caption 扩展成自由形式回答。训练目标仍是标准 next-token loss，但条件是音频前缀，目标是由 caption 派生出的文本响应。这样做的关键取舍是：不让 projector 学任务格式，而是让它学“音频语义如何被 LLM 读懂”。推理时再把用户文本指令交给冻结 LLM，利用其已有的 instruction-following 能力。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 MMAU、MMAR、MMSU、MMAU-Pro 等通用音频理解与推理 benchmark。论文报告称，alignment-only 模型在这些评测上可以匹配或超过经过较重 SFT/post-training 的开源 LALM，并使用更少训练数据；在 MMAU-Pro 的 instruction-following split 上，由于 LLM 完全冻结，原有指令跟随能力保留得更好。消融给出的主要结论是：性能上限同时受 audio encoder 信息量和 LLM 能力限制。增加 alignment 数据主要帮助开放式推理任务；封闭类别识别任务在 encoder 表征不足时很快饱和。encoder sweep 显示，不同 benchmark 的最好结果会跟随 encoder 预训练时强调的能力变化；LLM sweep 显示，该 recipe 可以迁移到不同代际 LLM，但需要注意用于生成训练文本的 LLM 与目标 LLM 的匹配。另一个实用结论是，不一定需要为每条音频生成密集 synthetic caption；多源、多样的开源 caption 聚合后也能支撑训练。提供内容中没有给出完整数据规模和逐项分数，精读时需要回到结果表确认。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对“alignment-only”假设的定义，再看 Methodology 中 projector、无指令训练目标和 self-generated data pipeline。实验部分重点看三类消融：alignment 数据规模、audio encoder 替换、LLM 替换。真正值得深挖的是饱和现象：哪些任务受 encoder 限制，哪些任务受 LLM 限制，哪些任务仍然能从数据扩展中受益。这个部分比单个 benchmark 分数更有信息量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether adapting a capable instruction-following LLM to audio really requires audio instruction tuning and preference optimization. Its answer is that a frozen audio encoder plus a frozen LLM, connected only by a trained lightweight projector, can already form a competitive general audio-language model when trained with instruction-free semantic alignment data.
summary_en.importance: The main value is the separation between modality alignment and task teaching. The LLM already contains a general instruction-following decoder; the audio encoder already contains modality-specific perceptual features. If both components are strong enough, the adaptation problem can be reduced to mapping audio representations into a space the LLM can interpret. This is useful for pretrain/post-train interface design, audio-language modeling, and multimodal adapter recipes. It is not a new language modeling objective, but it gives a clean test of how far frozen-component alignment can go.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system consists of a frozen audio encoder, a frozen autoregressive LLM, and a trainable projector. The encoder produces a sequence of audio features, and the projector maps them into the LLM input embedding space as a continuous prefix. Training removes task instructions entirely. Instead of manually writing QA pairs or instruction templates, the method treats audio captions as semantic proxies and uses an LLM to expand them into free-form responses. The model is then trained with the standard next-token objective conditioned on the projected audio prefix. The intended effect is to train the projector to express audio semantics in the LLM latent space, while leaving instruction following to the frozen LLM at inference time.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on MMAU, MMAR, MMSU, and MMAU-Pro. It reports that the alignment-only model can match or exceed more heavily post-trained open-source audio-language models while using substantially less data. On the instruction-following split of MMAU-Pro, freezing the LLM helps preserve its original instruction-following behavior. The ablations are more informative than the aggregate scores: scaling alignment data mainly helps open-ended reasoning tasks; closed-set recognition saturates quickly when the encoder lacks the needed information. Encoder sweeps show that benchmark performance tracks the capability emphasized during encoder pretraining. LLM sweeps suggest the recipe transfers across model generations, with a caveat that the generator used for synthetic responses should be well matched to the target LLM. The paper also finds that dense synthetic captions per sample are not strictly necessary; diverse open-source captions can work when aggregated. The provided content does not include full per-task numbers or dataset sizes, so the result tables should be checked directly.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for the main idea. Read the introduction for the alignment-only claim, then the methodology for the projector setup and instruction-free data construction. In the experiments, focus on the data scaling, encoder sweep, and LLM sweep rather than only the headline benchmark results. The most useful part is the saturation analysis, because it clarifies when the bottleneck is the audio encoder, when it is the LLM, and when more alignment data still helps.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 ablation；若 alignment-only 真能接近 SFT 管线，音频接入 LLM 的训练预算可以重算。
recommendation.en: Read the ablations; if alignment-only really approaches SFT pipelines, the training budget for adding audio to LLMs changes materially.

paper.title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Perception-Decision Misalignment in Omni-LLMs via Modality Subspace Activation
paper.abstract: Omni-Large Language Models (Omni-LLMs) power complex multi-modal reasoning in applications like World Action Models and autonomous agents. However, their strong performance often masks a profound Perceptual-Decision Misalignment (PDM), where decisions remain unfaithful to multi-modal perceptions. To diagnose this, we formalize Causal Modality Sensitivity (CMS), operationalized via a dual-lens framework: Answer Retention Rate (ARR) at the macro behavioral level, and Logit Angular Discrepancy (LAD

summary.core_problem: Omni-LLM 在多模态推理中存在感知—决策错位：即使移除关键感知模态，最终答案也几乎不变，说明决策主要被语言先验或参数记忆主导，而不是有效依赖视觉、音频等感知输入。
summary.importance: 对多模态基座研究有一定诊断价值。论文把“模型是否真的使用了某一模态”从粗粒度准确率推进到答案保持率和 logit 几何变化两个层面，并提出训练-free 的隐藏状态干预方法。对理解模态对齐、语言先验压制非文本模态、推理时表示校准有启发。但工作更偏 omni-model 评测与测试时干预，不是预训练目标或数据层面的核心改进，因此定为 skim。
summary.technical_approach: 先形式化 Causal Modality Sensitivity（CMS）：在输入模态受到扰动时，模型输出发生多大系统性变化。CMS 由两个指标组成：Answer Retention Rate（ARR）衡量模态扰动后模型是否仍保留原答案；Logit Angular Discrepancy（LAD）用 logit 方向的角度变化刻画多选分布的细粒度漂移。为减少语言先验和模态冗余的混淆，作者构建 CausalMSBench，强调问题必须严格依赖多模态信息。缓解方法是 Modality Subspace Activation（MSA）：收集不同受控模态输入下最后一层隐藏状态，对每个模态的激活矩阵做 SVD，得到模态子空间；推理时把当前隐藏状态投影到这些子空间，用 L2 范数估计各模态激活强度；若语言模态过强而关键感知模态过弱，则双向几何调节，抑制过激活方向、增强弱模态方向。
summary.experiments: 在 CausalMSBench 上，多个现有模型任务准确率尚可，但 CMS 偏低；常见模式是模态扰动后 ARR 很高，同时 LAD 有明显变化，说明最终答案没变但选项分布已经漂移，决策缺乏稳定的感知 grounding。应用 MSA 后，模型 ARR 降低、LAD 改善，即对模态扰动更敏感，表明感知信息更多参与决策。论文没有在提供片段中给出具体参数量、模型清单和完整数值表。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读。重点看 CMS/ARR/LAD 的定义、CausalMSBench 如何控制语言先验与模态依赖，以及 MSA 中用 SVD 构造模态子空间并在推理时调节隐藏状态的部分。若关注多模态表示分析，可细看 LAD 为什么比单看准确率更能暴露错位。预计 25–35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Omni-LLMs exhibit perception-decision misalignment: removing indispensable sensory modalities often causes little change in the final answer, suggesting that decisions are dominated by language priors or parametric memory rather than grounded perceptual evidence.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant as a diagnostic lens for multimodal foundation models. It moves beyond coarse accuracy and measures whether a model actually uses a modality through answer retention and logit-level geometric change, then proposes a training-free hidden-state intervention. It is useful for studying modality alignment, language-prior dominance, and inference-time representation calibration. It is not a core pretraining objective or data method, so it is a skim.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define Causal Modality Sensitivity (CMS) as systematic output divergence under input-modality perturbations. CMS combines Answer Retention Rate (ARR), which measures whether the original answer is retained after perturbation, and Logit Angular Discrepancy (LAD), which captures fine-grained distribution shift through angular change in the logit space. To reduce confounds from language priors and modality redundancy, they build CausalMSBench with questions designed to require strict multimodal dependency. The mitigation method, Modality Subspace Activation (MSA), collects last hidden states under controlled modality inputs, applies SVD to activation matrices to isolate modality-specific subspaces, projects inference-time hidden states onto those subspaces, uses L2 projection norms to estimate modality activation, and then performs dual-direction geometric regulation: suppressing over-activated directions while boosting weaker modality directions.
summary_en.experiments: On CausalMSBench, existing models show moderate task accuracy but low CMS. A common pattern is high ARR together with substantial LAD variation under modality perturbation: the final answer remains unchanged while the option distribution shifts, indicating weak perceptual grounding. MSA reduces ARR and improves LAD, increasing sensitivity to modality perturbations. Exact model names, parameter counts, and full numerical tables are not provided in the available excerpt.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper. Focus on the definitions of CMS, ARR, and LAD; the construction of CausalMSBench as a control for language priors and modality dependency; and the SVD-based modality subspace construction in MSA. Readers interested in multimodal representation analysis should examine why LAD exposes misalignment that accuracy alone misses. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 看 CMS/ARR-LAD 定义和 CausalMSBench 设计；若语言先验隔离不干净，MSA 增益只能当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read the CMS, ARR-LAD, and CausalMSBench setup; if language priors are not cleanly isolated, the MSA gains are only weak evidence.

paper.title: VADER: Adaptive Debiasing for Hallucination Mitigation in Video Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in open-ended video understanding, yet they remain prone to fluent responses unsupported by video evidence. Existing training-free methods typically apply a globally fixed visual intervention or construct a contrastive branch through input perturbation. The former cannot accommodate video-dependent fusion paths, while the latter can be compensated by cross-frame redundancy. We therefore propose Video-Adaptive Debiasing via

summary.core_problem: 视频大语言模型易生成缺乏视频证据支撑的幻觉，现有免训练方法要么使用全局固定视觉干预无法适配不同视频，要么通过输入扰动构造对比分支但被跨帧冗余抵消。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出免训练的视频自适应去偏框架，通过逐层视觉-文本证据流诊断与选择性证据擦除缓解视频LLM幻觉。
summary.technical_approach: 提出VADER：1) 视觉焦点重分配(VFR)：逐层诊断视觉到文本的证据流，确定干预层并将系统token注意力重分配到视频token；2) 选择性证据擦除(SEE)：独立掩码每帧高重要性视觉token，构造对比信号抑制无证据生成。
summary.experiments: 在开放域视频理解任务上对比现有免训练幻觉缓解方法，验证VFR与SEE的互补效果，具体提升幅度未在摘要中披露。

summary_en.core_problem: Video LLMs tend to hallucinate fluent responses unsupported by video evidence; existing training-free methods either apply globally fixed visual interventions or build contrastive branches via input perturbation that are canceled by cross-frame redundancy.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a training-free video-adaptive debiasing framework that mitigates video LLM hallucination through layer-wise visual-text evidence flow diagnosis and selective evidence erasure.
summary_en.technical_approach: VADER framework: 1) Visual Focus Reallocation (VFR) diagnoses layer-wise visual-to-text evidence flow, decides where to intervene, and reallocates pre-softmax attention from system tokens to video tokens; 2) Selective Evidence Erasure (SEE) masks high-importance visual tokens per frame independently to build contrastive signals against evidence-free generation.
summary_en.experiments: Compared with existing training-free hallucination mitigation methods on open-domain video understanding; concrete gains are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 免训练的视频LLM幻觉缓解方法，注意力重分配思路可参考做多模态对齐诊断，但属于后处理技巧，对预训练流程无直接启示，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: A training-free hallucination mitigation method for video LLMs; attention reallocation is useful for multimodal alignment diagnosis, but it is a post-processing trick with no direct pretraining implication—abstract suffices.

paper.title: Decoupling Perception from Description: Computation-Grounded Representation Alignment between Multivariate Time Series and Language
paper.abstract: Training multimodal models to align time series with language runs into a self-supervision trap. The usual recipe asks an LLM to read a series and write a description, so label quality is capped by the perceptual skill the model is supposed to learn. The data can never teach more than the labeler already knows. A second gap makes this worse: most datasets use a single variable, but the patterns that matter (cross-channel correlation, lead-lag structure, co-occurring anomalies) appear only with s

summary.core_problem: 解决时间序列与语言对齐中的标注瓶颈：让 LLM 直接观察时间序列并生成描述，会把训练信号限制在标注 LLM 自身的感知能力内。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态对齐数据构造方法。它指出 time-series-to-text 自监督存在“感知者也是教师”的闭环问题，尤其在多变量时间序列中，跨通道相关、lead-lag 结构、共现异常等模式很容易被弱标注器漏掉。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是把“感知”和“描述”解耦：先用确定性代码从真实开源多变量时间序列中计算统计事实，再让 LLM 只负责把这些已计算事实转写成自然语言。原创点不在模型结构，而在数据生成链路：用程序化测量替代 LLM 感知，用 LLM 保留语言表达能力。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整实验细节；可确认其数据来自真实开源多变量时间序列，并围绕多变量模式描述质量与可扩展性进行验证。未看到模型参数量、训练 token 数、baseline 名称或具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a labeling bottleneck in aligning multivariate time series with language: asking an LLM to inspect a series and write captions caps supervision quality at the labeler model’s own perceptual ability.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a multimodal data construction contribution. It identifies a self-supervision trap in time-series-to-text alignment, made worse in multivariate settings where cross-channel correlation, lead-lag relations, and co-occurring anomalies are hard for an LLM labeler to perceive reliably.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed recipe decouples perception from description. Deterministic code extracts statistical facts from real open-source multivariate time series, and an LLM verbalizes those precomputed facts. The novelty is the supervision pipeline rather than the model: computation handles measurement, while the LLM handles language realization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full experimental details. It states that the data are built from real open-source multivariate time series and evaluates the resulting alignment setup around realistic multivariate patterns. Model size, training scale, baselines, and exact gains are not visible from the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 不必读正文；记住“程序感知、LLM 表达”这个数据生成拆分，对多模态 caption 合成有可迁移价值。
recommendation.en: No need to read in full; the useful bit is the split between programmatic perception and LLM verbalization for multimodal caption synthesis.

paper.title: CARGO-VL: Counterfactual Arbitration with Risk-Constrained Group Optimization for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language systems combine images with retrieved text, but these sources can disagree or jointly fail to support an answer. Reliable models must identify the trustworthy source and abstain when neither is adequate. Existing post-training objectives score instances independently and therefore do not enforce coherent behavior under counterfactual evidence changes. We introduce CARGO-VL, a group-relative framework that optimizes matched variants covering aligned, image-correct, text-correct, a

summary.core_problem: 解决视觉语言系统中图像与检索文本来源冲突或共同失效时，无法可靠识别可信来源并适时弃权的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新+数据贡献，提出组相对优化框架处理多模态冲突，同时贡献四条件冲突训练资源XMC
summary.technical_approach: 提出CARGO-VL框架，将对齐、图像正确、文本正确、全错四种证据状态的变体作为一组优化，结合条件正确性与转换奖励（答案不变性、源等变性、答案到弃权切换），用原始对偶控制器平衡不安全回答和过度弃权
summary.experiments: 在XMC训练资源上训练，在CMC-Bench和Modality-Bias上做迁移评估，多种子实验显示冲突处理能力提升

summary_en.core_problem: Vision-language systems cannot reliably identify trustworthy sources or abstain when image and retrieved text conflict or both fail
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation plus data contribution; proposes group-relative optimization framework for multimodal conflict, and releases XMC four-condition conflict training resource
summary_en.technical_approach: CARGO-VL framework optimizes matched variants across aligned, image-correct, text-correct, both-wrong states as a bundle, combining condition-wise correctness with transition rewards, plus primal-dual controller for safety-abstention tradeoff
summary_en.experiments: Trained on XMC resource, evaluated on CMC-Bench and Modality-Bias for transfer; multi-seed experiments show improved conflict handling performance

recommendation.zh: VLM多模态冲突处理的增量改进方法，仅做多模态对齐研究的可扫一眼结果，纯LLM预训练研究员无需关注
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement for VLM multimodal conflict handling; only relevant for multimodal alignment researchers, skip for pure LLM pretraining

paper.title: Multimodal Alignment Through Joint Kernel Entropic Gromov--Wasserstein Optimal Transport
paper.abstract: We study the problem of aligning data from multiple modalities into a shared representation space, focusing on settings where strong pretrained unimodal encoders are available but cross-modal paired data are scarce. We propose a structure-preserving alignment framework, joint kernel entropic Gromov--Wasserstein Optimal Transport (JK-EGW), which maps multiple modalities into a common latent space by minimizing a quadratic optimal transport objective. JK-EGW leverages fine-grained similarity relat

summary.core_problem: 在跨模态配对数据稀缺但单模态预训练编码器可用时，如何把多个模态对齐到共享表示空间。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态表示对齐方法与理论分析。它不直接做 VLM 预训练，但触及一个重要接口：当 paired data 不足时，是否能利用模态内部结构关系完成弱配对或少配对对齐。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 joint kernel entropic Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport。方法不直接依赖原始特征空间距离，而是用模态内和模态间的细粒度相似关系构造全局 affinity kernel，再最小化二次 OT 目标，把多模态样本映射到共享 latent space。算法上使用可扩展的交替优化过程；理论上给出 n^{-1/2} 的参数样本复杂度。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体数据集、模型规模或提升幅度。实验信息只说明提出了 scalable alternating procedure；理论结果声称样本复杂度达到 n^{-1/2}，与 standard OT、entropic OT 和 Gromov-Wasserstein OT 的对应速率匹配。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses multimodal alignment when strong unimodal encoders exist but paired cross-modal data are scarce.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a representation-alignment method plus theory. It is not a VLM pretraining paper, but it is relevant to the pretraining interface where paired image-text or audio-text data are limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed joint kernel entropic Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport builds a global affinity kernel from fine-grained within- and cross-modality similarity relations, rather than relying on raw feature-space distances. It optimizes a quadratic OT objective to map modalities into a shared latent space and uses an alternating algorithm for scalability.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report datasets, model sizes, or empirical gains. The main stated result is theoretical: a parametric n^{-1/2} sample-complexity rate, matching rates for standard OT, entropic OT, and Gromov-Wasserstein OT.

recommendation.zh: 和 VLM 预训练只隔一层，建议只看目标函数和样本复杂度证明；没有规模实验前别高估可迁移性。
recommendation.en: One step away from VLM pretraining; read the objective and sample-complexity result, but do not overread it without scale experiments.

paper.title: Do Unified Multimodal Models Think in One Space? A Lens Through Cross-Branch Steering
paper.abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) aim to integrate understanding and generation within a single architecture, yet it remains unclear whether these capabilities share a unified and transferable semantic space. This question is fundamentally challenging, as the two branches operate over heterogeneous representations (text tokens vs.\ visual latents) and distinct training objectives, making direct comparison difficult. To address this, we introduce \emph{cross-branch semantic steering}, an intervent

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究统一多模态模型的理解分支和生成分支是否共享同一个语义空间，而不只是共享一个外观上的模型框架。
summary.importance: 对统一多模态预训练有明确启发。很多 UMM 同时做图像理解和图像生成，但这不保证两个分支内部的语义表示是可迁移的。论文用 intervention 而不是相关性分析来检测这一点：如果从理解分支学到的语义方向能改变生成结果，才说明两个分支至少共享了一部分可操作的语义子空间。结论也比较具体：理解到生成可以迁移，生成到理解基本失败。这提示预训练设计不能只把任务塞进同一个 backbone，还需要让生成侧的 latent 表示对齐到对象、属性、关系等抽象语义，而不是主要承载颜色、光照、背景这类低层外观统计。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 cross-branch semantic steering。核心思想是不直接比较 text tokens 和 visual latents 的表示，因为两者 token 类型和训练目标都不同，而是做因果干预。具体做法是从一个分支提取语义 steering vector，例如“red → pink”，再在另一个分支推理时注入这个向量。如果理解分支得到的方向能让生成分支把 red ribbon 画成 pink ribbon，就说明该方向跨分支可用。作者构造 UMMSteer 数据集，包含 51 组视觉语义概念对，覆盖颜色、文字、数量、位置、风格、外观和 persona。理解侧的向量主要来自文本 QA 样本的表示差分；生成侧向量则来自生成过程中的 latent 表示。论文还分析了迁移不对称性的来源：理解侧方向更偏组合式、对象中心的语义，因此能被生成分支利用；生成侧方向更多捕捉背景色调、光照、全局颜色分布等低层外观特征，与理解分支的语义结构不匹配。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕跨分支 steering 的可迁移性展开。作者首先在目标 UMM 上展示 understanding-to-generation 的成功案例：从理解分支抽取的概念方向可以改变图像生成中的属性，同时提升语义忠实度。反向的 generation-to-understanding 基本不能稳定改变理解分支预测，形成明显不对称。作者进一步在 Janus-Pro、UniPic-1 等其他统一多模态模型上验证，发现强任务性能并不自动意味着理解和生成分支有良好的共享语义空间；对齐程度与架构设计和模态融合方式有关。提供内容没有给出完整指标表和具体成功率，因此更适合作为机制诊断工作阅读，而不是按单一分数比较模型。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 分钟。重点看 cross-branch steering 的定义、steering vector 的提取位置和注入位置、UMMSteer 的 51 个概念对设计，以及 understanding-to-generation 和 generation-to-understanding 的对照实验。真正值得深挖的是失败方向：生成侧表示为什么偏低层外观，是否由 diffusion/latent decoder 训练目标造成，以及预训练中能否加入跨分支一致性 loss，让生成 latent 更显式地承载对象和关系语义。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether unified multimodal models actually learn a shared semantic space between their understanding branch and generation branch, rather than merely placing both functions inside one architecture.
summary_en.importance: The work is useful for multimodal pretraining because it separates architectural unification from representational unification. A model can perform both VQA and image generation while still using poorly aligned internal spaces. The diagnostic is intervention-based: a semantic direction extracted from one branch must causally affect the other branch to count as transferable. The main finding is asymmetric. Understanding-to-generation transfer works, while generation-to-understanding transfer largely fails. This suggests that unified pretraining needs stronger pressure to align generation latents with object-level and relation-level semantics, not only with low-level visual appearance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce cross-branch semantic steering. Instead of directly comparing text-token representations with visual latents, they extract a steering vector for a concept pair, such as red to pink, from one branch and inject it into the other during inference. If a vector learned from the understanding branch changes the generated image in the intended semantic direction, that is causal evidence for a shared usable subspace. The paper builds UMMSteer, a visually grounded contrastive dataset with 51 concept pairs covering color, text, counting, position, style, appearance, and persona. Understanding-side vectors are derived from text-based QA representations, while generation-side vectors are derived from latent generation representations. The asymmetry is attributed to a mismatch in abstraction level: understanding vectors tend to encode compositional, object-centric semantics, whereas generation vectors often capture background tone, illumination, and global color statistics.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments test steering transfer across branches. In the main direction, understanding-derived vectors can steer generation and improve semantic faithfulness, such as shifting a prompted red object toward the target color. In the reverse direction, generation-derived vectors do not reliably alter understanding predictions. The authors also test other UMMs, including Janus-Pro and UniPic-1, and find that strong task performance does not necessarily imply aligned cross-branch representations. The supplied text does not include full numeric tables or success rates, so the result should be read primarily as a representational diagnostic rather than a leaderboard-style comparison.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20-minute skim is appropriate. Read the cross-branch steering setup, where vectors are extracted and injected, the UMMSteer concept-pair design, and the asymmetric transfer results. The most interesting technical question is why generation-side latents remain appearance-heavy, and whether multimodal pretraining objectives can add cross-branch consistency so that generation representations carry more explicit object and relation semantics.

recommendation.zh: 做多模态统一预训练的可重点看§4的不对称性分析，setup干净，对理解生成分支的对齐目标设计有直接参考价值
recommendation.en: Multimodal pretraining researchers should focus on §4’s asymmetry analysis; the clean setup offers direct reference for aligning understanding and generation branch objectives

paper.title: Adversarial Style Optimization: Enhancing VLM Jailbreaks by GRPO-based Stylistic Triggers Optimization
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive performance, but their safety alignment remains vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. Existing content-based jailbreaks are often inconsistent and show unsatisfying performance against the rapidly evolving MLLMs, failing to exploit non-content-based vulnerabilities. Unlike previous research, we empirically find that MLLMs exhibit a Stylistic Inconsistency between their comprehension ability and safety ability: MLLMs can robustly unders

summary.core_problem: 研究 MLLM 安全对齐在视觉风格扰动下的脆弱性：模型能理解同一内容，但安全拒答机制可能被特定视觉风格触发绕过。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态安全攻击方法与现象观察。它把 jailbreak 从内容级 adversarial prompt 扩展到非内容的视觉风格维度，对理解 VLM 对齐边界有一定价值，但更偏攻击工程，不直接推进预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Adversarial Style Optimization。方法将已有 adversarial image 作为输入，训练或微调一个图像编辑模型叠加风格化修改；优化信号来自一个 GRPO agent，并使用分层结构化 reward 评估攻击成功、内容保真和风格触发效果。核心是把风格当成可优化的 jailbreak trigger，而不是直接改有害内容。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示在快速演进的 MLLM 上验证 ASO 可以增强已有视觉 jailbreak 的稳定性，但未给出具体模型列表、样本规模、攻击成功率提升幅度或防御 baseline 细节。需要看正文确认 setup 是否覆盖闭源/开源 MLLM、是否控制了内容可见性与图像编辑 artifact。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自清华大学、哈尔滨工程大学、山东大学、西安电子科技大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a safety weakness in MLLMs where visual style changes can bypass refusal behavior while preserving semantic comprehension.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal safety attack and an empirical observation about style-conditioned alignment failures. It is relevant to VLM robustness, but it is closer to attack engineering than to pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Adversarial Style Optimization module takes an existing adversarial image and uses an image-editing model to overlay optimized stylistic modifications. A GRPO agent, guided by a structurally tiered reward, optimizes the style trigger for attack success, semantic preservation, and compatibility with the base jailbreak.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims improved jailbreak performance against evolving MLLMs, but it does not specify the evaluated model set, dataset size, attack success rate gains, or defense baselines. The key checks are whether the setup controls for content leakage, edit artifacts, and transfer across open and closed models.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Tsinghua University, Harbin Engineering University, Shandong University, and Xidian University.

recommendation.zh: 可扫现象和 reward 设计；若风格触发可跨模型迁移，它是 VLM 对齐的真实坑，否则只是又一个 jailbreak wrapper。
recommendation.en: Skim the phenomenon and reward design; cross-model transfer would make it a real VLM alignment issue, otherwise it is mostly another jailbreak wrapper.

paper.title: KALE: Kernel Alignment with Loss Equilibration for Stable CLIP-DINOv2 Alignment at Web Scale
paper.abstract: Kernel-based alignment of CLIP toward a vision centric teacher such as DINOv2 (KUEA) improves CLIP's visual representations while preserving text-encoder compatibility, using a fixed trade-off weight tuned on curated ImageNet-1K. We ask whether this transfers to noisy, web-scale data (CC12M) and find that it does not: the alignment term's weighted contribution falls to about 0.2% of the clean term, so under any fixed weight its gradient is effectively inert. We introduce KALE, a loss-equilibrati

summary.core_problem: 现有基于核对齐的CLIP→DINOv2视觉表征对齐方法（KUEA）在ImageNet-1K这类人工筛选的干净小规模数据集上有效，但迁移到CC12M这类高噪声、强异质性的网络规模数据时，固定权重的多损失平衡机制完全失效：对齐损失的加权贡献仅为CLIP特征正则项的0.2%，梯度几乎消失，无法产生有效训练信号；盲目调高对齐权重又会导致训练后期对齐项主导优化，让视觉表征过度偏离原始CLIP的嵌入空间，破坏已有的图文匹配能力。不存在一个通用固定权重能同时适配不同数据分布和训练配置。
summary.importance: 量化了跨模型/跨模态对齐训练中一个普遍存在但此前未被系统刻画的失效模式：在干净小规模数据上调好的固定损失权重，在噪声网络规模数据上会出现量级级的失配，导致训练信号消失或崩溃。提出的自适应损失平衡方案无需逐数据集调参，为web规模下的表征对齐、蒸馏、多目标联合训练提供了可直接迁移的稳定训练思路，对VLM预训练的对齐损失设计有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 在KUEA核对齐框架基础上，将固定的对齐损失权重替换为KALE动态平衡控制器：实时跟踪核对齐损失和CLIP特征保持损失的滑动平均，自适应缩放对齐项的权重，让两个损失的比例稳定维持在预设目标值，既保证对齐项在训练全程有足够的梯度贡献，又避免对齐过强导致表征漂移。训练策略上配合使用带中等学习率下限的余弦衰减schedule，同时将峰值学习率控制在稳定区间内，避免训练崩溃或对齐不足。
summary.experiments: 在CLIP ViT-L/14上使用CC12M的3.3M子集开展训练：1）量化损失失配程度：web数据上需要将对齐权重较ImageNet上的常用值提高约4个数量级才能达到有效平衡，且最优权重随训练配置变化，不存在通用固定值；2）性能表现：相比原始CLIP，KALE训练的模型零样本分类平均准确率提升2.0个点，超过在ImageNet上训练的KUEA实现的1.29个点提升，同时完整保留图文检索性能，SVHN线性探针精度稳定提升；3）消融实验显示：峰值学习率需要足够高才能让控制器有效跟踪对齐信号，但过高会导致训练崩溃；学习率完全衰减到0或保持恒定都会造成表征漂移过大或对齐不足，带适度下限的余弦schedule效果最优；所有结果均报告了多次训练的run-to-run方差，结果可复现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言和训练动态分析部分的损失量级量化、学习率与schedule的消融结果，不需要深究核对齐的具体数学形式。预计阅读时间15分钟。核心可迁移的洞察是：涉及对齐、蒸馏的多损失联合预训练场景中，固定损失权重对噪声数据的鲁棒性极差，基于滑动损失平均的动态量级平衡可以低成本解决这一问题，不需要手动调参。

summary_en.core_problem: Fixed-weight kernel alignment of CLIP visual encoders to DINOv2 teachers (KUEA) performs well on small curated datasets like ImageNet-1K, but breaks down on noisy, heterogeneous web-scale data such as CC12M. The alignment loss magnitude collapses to roughly 0.2% of the CLIP feature preservation regularizer under web noise, rendering its gradients effectively inert; naively increasing the fixed weight causes the alignment term to dominate late training, drifting representations too far from CLIP's original embedding space and breaking text-image compatibility. No universal fixed weight works across data distributions and training configurations.
summary_en.importance: This work quantifies a common, under-documented failure mode in cross-model and cross-modal alignment at web scale: fixed loss weights tuned on small clean benchmarks suffer order-of-magnitude mismatch on noisy web data, leading to either dead gradients or training collapse. The proposed tuning-free adaptive loss balancing scheme provides a stable, transferable recipe for web-scale representation alignment, distillation, and multi-objective joint training, with direct practical relevance to VLM pretraining alignment loss design.
summary_en.technical_approach: KALE replaces the fixed alignment weight in the KUEA framework with a running-loss controller that tracks exponential moving averages of both the kernel alignment loss and the CLIP feature preservation loss, adaptively rescaling the alignment weight to maintain a preset target ratio between the two terms. This guarantees consistent gradient contribution from the alignment term throughout training without causing excessive representational drift. The controller is paired with a cosine learning rate schedule with a moderate floor (instead of a fully decayed or flat schedule), and a bounded peak learning rate chosen to avoid both collapse and insufficient alignment.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments train CLIP ViT-L/14 on a 3.3M subset of CC12M: (1) Loss mismatch is quantified: functional alignment on web data requires ~4 orders of magnitude higher alignment weight than used on ImageNet, with optimal weights varying across configurations, making fixed weights infeasible. (2) KALE improves average zero-shot classification by +2.0 points over the base CLIP model, outperforming ImageNet-trained KUEA's +1.29 point gain, while fully preserving image-text retrieval performance and delivering consistent SVHN linear probe improvements. (3) Ablations show peak learning rate must be high enough for the controller to track alignment signal but bounded to avoid collapse; cosine decay with a moderate LR floor outperforms both fully decayed and flat schedules by preventing excessive drift. All results include explicit run-to-run variance measurements for reproducibility.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim this work. Focus on the introduction and training dynamics sections covering loss magnitude mismatch and learning rate/schedule ablations; the mathematical details of polynomial kernel alignment are not critical for general pretraining researchers. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes. The core transferable insight is that fixed loss weights for alignment and distillation objectives are poorly robust to noisy web data, and simple running-average magnitude balancing eliminates per-dataset tuning across a wide range of multi-objective pretraining setups.

recommendation.zh: 只看 loss-ratio controller 和 CC12M 失败分析；这类尺度失衡在 VLM mid-train 里很容易复现。
recommendation.en: Skim the loss-ratio controller and the CC12M failure analysis; this kind of scale mismatch is easy to reproduce in VLM mid-training.

paper.title: SIVA-RL: Sensitivity-Invariance Visual Alignment for Multimodal Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) drives multimodal reasoning, but answer-level correctness does not guarantee that a vision-language model grounds its predictions in visual evidence. Existing visual-intervention methods contrast policy behavior on original and modified images, yet assign supervision by the type of intervention rather than its observed effect. This assumption fails: identical operators produce heterogeneous outcomes across samples. We propose SIVA-RL, a Sensi

summary.core_problem: 多模态强化学习（RLVR）中答案级正确无法保证VLM的预测真正基于视觉证据，现有视觉干预方法按干预类型分配监督而非实际效果，同操作在不同样本上效果差异大。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出基于干预实际效果的样本级视觉对齐框架，改进多模态RL模型的视觉grounded性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SIVA-RL框架，用样本级结果条件监督替代操作条件正则；通过token对齐、距离约束的PatchSwap构造局部图像干预；用冻结审计策略打分干净-干预对的奖励下降幅度作为软路由权重，分别驱动敏感性对齐（大降样本）和不变性对齐（低降样本）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未明确给出模型参数量、训练数据规模及具体基线对比数值，仅披露框架设计思路。

summary_en.core_problem: In multimodal reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), answer-level correctness does not guarantee VLM predictions are grounded in visual evidence; existing visual intervention methods assign supervision by intervention type rather than actual effect, leading to inconsistent outcomes across samples.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing a sample-wise outcome-conditioned visual alignment framework to improve visual grounding in multimodal RL.
summary_en.technical_approach: SIVA-RL replaces operator-conditioned regularization with sample-wise outcome-conditioned supervision; constructs localized interventions via token-aligned, distance-constrained PatchSwap; uses a frozen audit policy to score reward drops on clean-intervention pairs as soft routing weights, driving sensitivity alignment for high-drop pairs and invariance alignment for low-drop pairs.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not specify model size, training data scale, or quantitative baseline comparisons, only discloses framework design.

recommendation.zh: 多模态RL视觉对齐的增量工作，干预效果驱动监督的思路可作设计参考，无需深读正文。
recommendation.en: Incremental work on multimodal RL visual alignment; the outcome-conditioned supervision idea is useful as design reference, no need for deep reading.

paper.title: Groc-PO: Grounded Context Preference Optimization for Truthful Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Despite the rapid progress of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), they still suffer from untruthfulness issues, such as visual hallucinations, content fabrication, and unfaithful reasoning, which substantially undermine their faithfulness and practical utility. Alignment methods based on human preference, such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), have been widely adopted to address these issues. However, multimodal reasoning errors often propagate across stages, and final-answer errors

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态大模型在视觉问答与推理中出现的幻觉、内容编造和不忠实推理问题，尤其是标准偏好优化只在最终答案层面监督、难以纠正早期 grounding 错误的信用分配缺陷。
summary.importance: 这是一个后训练对齐方向的方法改进，贡献点在于把多模态偏好优化从“只看最终答案”推进到“显式约束中间 grounding 上下文”。对做 MLLM 对齐的人有参考价值，但对基座预训练本身的直接推动有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Groc-PO（Grounded Context Preference Optimization），核心思路是在偏好优化中引入 grounded context 级别的监督，而不是仅比较最终回答优劣。方法试图把多模态推理拆成早期视觉 grounding 与后续答案生成两个层次，在训练时对中间上下文一致性、证据对齐和阶段性错误传播进行约束，从而缓解 grounding drift 导致的后续错误放大。整体属于 DPO 在多模态 truthful alignment 场景下的结构化改造，而不是新的预训练范式。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可见，论文主要比较标准 DPO 式方法与其 grounded preference 变体在多模态真实性相关任务上的表现，关注视觉幻觉、事实一致性和推理忠实度。摘要未给出明确模型规模、训练数据量和具体提升幅度，因此目前更适合作为方法思路了解，而不是据此更新强结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中国科学技术大学、小米、传播内容认知全国重点实验室、人民网。不是当前多模态对齐领域最强信号团队，但有产学结合背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets untruthfulness in multimodal LLMs—visual hallucination, fabrication, and unfaithful reasoning—arguing that standard preference optimization only supervises final answers and fails to correct early grounding errors.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training alignment contribution rather than a pretraining one. Its value lies in moving multimodal preference optimization from answer-level supervision to intermediate grounding-aware supervision, which is useful for MLLM alignment but only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Groc-PO, a grounded context preference optimization framework. The key idea is to optimize preferences not only over final responses but also over grounded intermediate context, so that early-stage visual grounding and context consistency receive direct training signal. In effect, it restructures DPO for multimodal truthful reasoning by addressing credit assignment across reasoning stages, rather than introducing a new pretraining objective.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the evaluation appears to compare standard DPO-style baselines against the proposed grounded preference variant on multimodal truthfulness settings, focusing on hallucination, factual faithfulness, and reasoning fidelity. The abstract does not expose model size, data scale, or exact gains, so the evidence should be treated as directional until the full setup is inspected.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from USTC, Xiaomi, the State Key Laboratory of Communication Content Cognition, and People’s Daily Online. This is a credible academic-industry collaboration, though not a top-tier signal source for changing priors on multimodal alignment.

recommendation.zh: 这是把 DPO 信号往中间 grounding 迁移的一次合理改造；对做 MLLM 对齐可借鉴，但离 pretrain 较远，先看方法图和误差分解就够了。
recommendation.en: A sensible extension of DPO toward intermediate grounding supervision; useful if you work on MLLM alignment, but too far from pretraining to warrant a full read—method figure and error analysis are enough.

paper.title: MIRTH: Mutual-Information Reasoning with Temporal Hubs for Vision-Language-Action Agents
paper.abstract: VLA models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for transferring semantic knowledge from web-scale data to physical robotic control. However, current single-frame architectures suffer from intrinsic limitations: temporal myopia that discards historical dynamics, reasoning gaps between high-level instructions and low-level motor commands, and inference inefficiency due to autoregressive scalar decoding. In this work, we propose MIRTH, a unified framework designed to address these challenges. MIRTH

summary.core_problem: 当前单帧 VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型存在时间近视、高层指令与低层动作推理断层、自回归解码推理慢三大局限。
summary.importance: 方法创新，在预训练 VLA 骨架上提出三方面改进：时序记忆压缩、互信息潜变量规划、并行动作解码，面向机器人控制场景。
summary.technical_approach: 1) 双尺度时序 hub 压缩长期场景演化与短期运动趋势为紧凑嵌入；2) 通过互信息目标优化潜推理 token，对齐多模态上下文与动作轨迹的语义规划空间；3) 用向量级并行预测替代自回归标量解码以提升控制吞吐。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型参数量、训练数据规模与量化提升幅度，仅说明在多个机器人控制任务上做了广泛实验验证。
summary.authors_note: 无法从摘要确认机构与作者背景，返回空字符串。

summary_en.core_problem: Current single-frame Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models suffer from temporal myopia, a reasoning gap between high-level instructions and low-level motor commands, and slow autoregressive decoding.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation on top of a pretrained VLA backbone, introducing three targeted improvements for robotic control: temporal memory compression, mutual-information latent planning, and parallel action decoding.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Dual-scale temporal hubs that compress long-term scene evolution and short-term motion trends into compact embeddings; 2) latent reasoning tokens optimized via a mutual-information objective to align multimodal context with action trajectories in a semantic plan space; 3) vector-wise parallel action prediction replacing autoregressive scalar decoding for higher control throughput.
summary_en.experiments: Concrete model sizes, training data scale, and quantitative improvement margins are not disclosed in the abstract; extensive experiments on multiple robotic control tasks are claimed.

recommendation.zh: 机器人 VLA 方向的增量改进，互信息潜 token 设计对多模态对齐有弱参考，看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: An incremental improvement in robotic VLA; the mutual-information latent token design has weak relevance to multimodal alignment, read only the method section.

paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) inherit rich relational priors from their language backbones, yet often fail when asked to apply these relationships in visual contexts. We trace this failure to a structural blind spot: projection-based alignment trains each visual token to carry the right semantics, but never asks whether the relationships between concepts survive the crossing from language to vision. To address this, we propose MIRROR (Mapping Inter-concept Relations from language to v

summary.core_problem: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在将语言中的关系先验应用到视觉上下文中时经常失败，如何解决这种跨模态关系对齐的结构性盲点？
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于最优传输的几何正则化框架，首次从关系结构对齐的角度解决图文跨模态对齐问题，而非仅仅是 token 级别的语义对齐。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MIRROR 框架，通过半逆 Gromov-Wasserstein (SI-GW) 问题推导出一个代理损失函数。该方法利用语言表示中编码的丰富关系结构，将关系先验从语言迁移到视觉，实现视觉表示与语言衍生关系先验的几何对齐。
summary.experiments: 论文提出了理论推导，证明了该公式具有唯一解，但摘要未提供具体的实验设置和结果数据。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often fail to apply relational priors from language to visual contexts. How to address this structural blind spot in cross-modal relational alignment?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a geometric regularization framework based on optimal transport, addressing cross-modal alignment from the perspective of relational structure rather than just token-level semantic alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the MIRROR framework, deriving a surrogate loss from the proposed Semi-Inverse Gromov-Wasserstein (SI-GW) problem. This approach transfers relational priors from language to vision by exploiting the relational structure encoded in language representations, aligning visual representations geometrically.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions theoretical proof of a unique solution but lacks specific experimental setups and quantitative results.

recommendation.zh: 用最优传输做图文关系对齐，数学上比较漂亮，但作为 pretrain researcher 仅需了解其思路，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Uses optimal transport for image-text relational alignment; mathematically elegant but only worth a glance for pretrain researchers.

paper.title: Personalizing MLLMs via Reinforced Multimodal Reference Game
paper.abstract: Personalizing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) aims to recognize users' unique concepts from visual data and provide personalized responses. Although prior work has shown the benefit of concept descriptions and reasoning for this task, MLLM descriptions often include information, such as state and context, that does not help and may in fact hinder the unique identification of the target concept among other visually similar items. Effective descriptions of personal concepts should instead

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 MLLM 个性化里的一个具体瓶颈：模型虽然能根据用户提供的参考图像或概念描述去识别“我的杯子”“我的衣服”这类私有概念，但它生成的描述往往混入场景、姿态、背景、摆放位置这类可变信息，真正有区分度、且跨视角稳定的属性反而不够突出。结果是，描述看起来完整，却不利于在一组相似候选中稳定找出目标概念。作者把问题重新定义为一个 reference game：好的描述不是“像 caption 一样尽量全”，而是要让另一个模型在 hard negatives 和 hard positives 的干扰下仍能准确指认目标。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接价值不在于个性化应用本身，而在于它给出了一种较干净的 RL 训练信号设计：用可验证的博弈结果替代昂贵且主观的描述标注，去优化“判别性表达”而不是通用 caption 质量。这个思路和预训练/后训练接口是相关的，因为它说明多模态模型可以通过任务结构化，把原本难监督的语言行为转成 outcome-based reward。贡献量级偏中等，更像一个训练范式上的好例子，而不是会改变通用 MLLM 预训练路线的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Reinforced Reference Game, RRG。一个 MLLM 在训练中轮流扮演 speaker 和 listener。speaker 看到目标概念的图像后生成描述；listener 再根据该描述，在候选图像集合中选出对应概念。奖励不来自人工写好的“标准描述”，而来自 listener 是否选对。

关键设计有三点。第一，候选集不是随机构造，而是刻意做 hard contrastive setup。正样本侧使用同一概念的不同视角、不同背景、不同状态图像，迫使 speaker 放弃“挂在衣架上”“在桌子左边”这类不稳定线索；负样本侧使用同语义类别、视觉上相近的概念，迫使 speaker 说出真正能区分目标的细粒度属性。第二，训练目标不是让 speaker 更像 captioner，而是让它学会压缩到“可识别且稳定”的属性子集。第三，speaker 用 GRPO 优化，因为 reward 来自博弈成败，天然是 outcome-level、可验证、但不可微的信号。

从全文表述看，这个方法和已有 personalization 路线的区别比较明确。相比 test-time 学习概念表示的方法，它不需要每来一个新概念就重新优化；相比直接检索参考图像再推理的方法，它试图先把概念表示提纯成更稳的文本描述；相比模板式描述方法，它不依赖人工先验模板；相比一般 RL-based personalization，它的 reward 不是模糊偏好分，而是由 reference game 给出的任务正确性信号，监督更直接。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 MyVLM、Yo’LLaVA、PerVA 三个个性化 benchmark，任务包括 captioning 和 VQA。作者的主结论是：RRG 训练出的描述模型能稳定提升下游个性化识别与回答，优于已有 training-based 方法，也优于替代性的 description-based 方法和 RL-based 方法。全文给出的重点不是超大规模训练，而是说明描述质量和判别性之间的因果关系：当描述包含状态、背景、位置等信息时，跨视角泛化会变差；当训练中加入 hard positives 与 hard negatives 后，模型更倾向于输出稳定属性，listener 识别准确率和最终 personalization 指标都会提升。

从文中结构看，Sec. 4.3 专门做了“描述本身作用”的动机实验，这部分比总表更值得看，因为它回答了为什么 generic caption 不够用。另一个重点是 reward ablation：作者分析了 reward 设计对最终描述风格和识别性能的影响，说明 reference-game reward 不是简单地把 RL 套上去，而是通过候选构造把训练信号变得有信息量。当前给出的全文片段没有完整数表，因此不适合编造具体百分点；但可以确认的是，作者声称在三套数据上的 captioning 达到最优，VQA 也优于现有 training-based 基线，并且对 unseen concepts 有泛化能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和 Fig. 1，把作者对“好描述”的定义吃透：准确、可区分、去除干扰、跨状态稳定。然后直接看方法部分里 speaker/listener 的训练流程，以及 hard positives / hard negatives 的构造方式，这是整篇最有信息量的地方。实验部分优先看三块：一是主结果表，确认它相对 description-based 与 RL-based 基线的提升位置；二是 Sec. 4.3 关于描述质量的分析；三是 reward ablation，判断 RL 信号到底来自哪里。预计 25-35 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。如果只关心对基座训练的启发，重点不是 personalization 指标本身，而是“如何把难标注的语言行为改写成可验证博弈任务”。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in MLLM personalization: models can use user-provided reference images or concept memories, but the descriptions they produce often contain contextual or transient details—background, pose, placement, current state—rather than the stable, discriminative attributes needed to identify a personal concept among visually similar candidates. The authors recast personalization as a reference game, where a good description is not a generic caption but a message that lets another model reliably pick the target under hard ambiguity.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for foundation-model research is not personalization per se, but the training signal design. The work shows how to optimize a hard-to-annotate language behavior—discriminative multimodal description—using verifiable game outcomes instead of human-written target descriptions. That makes it relevant to the pretrain/post-train interface: it is an example of turning subjective generation quality into outcome-based reinforcement learning. The contribution is moderate in scope: more a useful training recipe and problem formulation than a shift in general MLLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, Reinforced Reference Game (RRG), trains an MLLM to alternate between two roles. As a speaker, it observes the target concept and generates a description. As a listener, it uses that description to identify the target from a candidate set. The speaker is optimized with GRPO using the game outcome as reward.

Three design choices matter. First, the candidate set is deliberately hard. Hard positives are different views or states of the same concept, which penalizes descriptions that rely on unstable cues such as background or object state. Hard negatives are visually similar items from the same semantic class, which forces the speaker to mention truly distinguishing attributes. Second, the objective is not to improve generic caption quality, but to compress the description into the subset of attributes that are both stable and discriminative. Third, the reward is verifiable and task-grounded: success is defined by whether the listener can recover the target, not by matching a reference sentence.

Relative to prior personalization methods, the distinction is clear. It avoids per-concept test-time optimization, unlike methods that learn concept-specific representations on the fly. It is less dependent on raw image reasoning than retrieval-plus-reasoning approaches, because it tries to distill the concept into a cleaner textual representation. It also differs from template-based description methods by learning the description policy rather than prescribing a format, and from generic RL personalization by using a sharper reward tied to reference-game success.
summary_en.experiments:
Experiments are conducted on MyVLM, Yo’LLaVA, and PerVA, covering personalized captioning and VQA. The main empirical claim is that RRG improves personalization performance over prior training-based methods, as well as over alternative description-based and RL-based baselines. The paper’s more interesting evidence is not just the headline tables, but the analysis of why descriptions matter: generic captions tend to include mutable or distracting details, while the proposed hard-positive/hard-negative setup pushes the model toward invariant and discriminative attributes, which in turn improves listener identification and downstream personalization metrics.

Section 4.3 appears especially important because it isolates the role of description quality. The reward ablations are also central: they show that the gains do not come from adding RL in the abstract, but from shaping the game so that the reward carries useful information about what should and should not be said. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete numeric tables, so exact percentages should be read from the paper itself. What is clear from the text is that the method reports top captioning results on all three benchmarks, stronger VQA accuracy than existing training-based baselines, and generalization to unseen concepts.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and Figure 1. The key idea is the paper’s definition of a good personalized description: accurate, discriminative, free of distracting details, and stable across state changes. Then go straight to the method section and focus on how the speaker/listener game is constructed, especially the hard positives and hard negatives. In the experiments, prioritize three parts: the main comparison tables, Section 4.3 on the role of descriptions, and the reward ablations. A useful skim should take about 25–35 minutes. If your interest is foundation-model training rather than personalization itself, the main takeaway is how to convert a difficult generation objective into a verifiable multimodal game.

recommendation.zh: 读 reference-game reward 设计即可；它比“让模型多描述一点”更像可复用的多模态后训练信号。
recommendation.en: Read the reference-game reward design; it is a more reusable multimodal post-training signal than longer descriptions.

paper.title: Balancing Performance and Diversity in GRPO Autoregressive Text-to-Image Post-Training
paper.abstract: Autoregressive text-to-image (T2I) generation has recently advanced rapidly, yet aligning generated images with human preferences remains challenging. GRPO-style online reinforcement learning provides an effective framework; however, existing methods typically treat reference-policy divergence as fixed, despite its direct impact on policy optimization. We study this overlooked factor within a unified f-divergence framework, encompassing forward KL, reverse KL, and JS divergence, for GRPO-style a

summary.core_problem: 自回归文生图模型采用GRPO做在线RL偏好对齐时，参考策略的散度正则项普遍默认使用反向KL，学界尚未系统研究不同f散度选择对token级优化动态、最终生成效果中性能与多样性权衡的具体影响。
summary.importance: 研究针对AR文生图GRPO对齐场景提出的f散度梯度塑形分析框架可迁移至通用大模型GRPO训练，打破了此前参考正则默认固定用反向KL的设计惯性，为多模态自回归模型的RL对齐训练提供了可解释的超参选择依据。
summary.technical_approach: 将GRPO的参考策略正则统一到通用f-divergence框架下，覆盖正向KL、反向KL、JS散度三类典型选择，推导得到不同散度下的token级闭环更新规则：所有散度对训练的影响完全通过f’(w)项作用（w为当前策略与参考策略在单token步的重要性比率）。反向KL在w=1（策略与参考完全一致）处仍存在正偏移，会持续鼓励策略偏离参考，易引发模式崩塌、生成多样性下降；正向KL梯度恒为负，会过度压制策略更新幅度；JS散度在w=1处偏移为0，对大幅偏离参考的更新抑制更平缓，可同时兼顾偏好对齐效果与生成多样性。
summary.experiments: 在控制采样策略、优势计算、训练调度、超参完全一致的AR文生图GRPO对照实验中，JS正则的人类偏好对齐得分与反向KL持平，生成多样性显著高于反向KL基线；消融实验观测到的优化动态与梯度塑形理论推导完全吻合。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议用15分钟阅读核心内容，重点关注第3节不同f散度下的梯度塑形推导，以及三类散度f’(w)曲线的特性对比；实验部分仅需浏览性能-多样性权衡的主结果，无需细读实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: GRPO-based online RL alignment for autoregressive text-to-image models uniformly adopts reverse KL as the fixed reference policy divergence penalty, with no systematic analysis of how divergence choice shapes token-level optimization dynamics and the tradeoff between generation quality and output diversity.
summary_en.importance: The proposed f-divergence gradient shaping analysis generalizes beyond T2I post-training to standard LLM GRPO pipelines, challenging the default convention of using reverse KL for reference regularization, and providing an interpretable design guide for RL alignment of autoregressive multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work unifies GRPO reference policy regularization under a general f-divergence framework covering forward KL, reverse KL, and Jensen-Shannon divergence. Closed-form token-level update rules are derived for each variant, showing all divergence effects act solely through the f'(w) term where w is the per-token importance ratio between current and reference policy: reverse KL retains a positive offset at w=1, biasing updates toward policy deviation and causing mode collapse; forward KL has strictly negative gradients that over-constrain policy updates; JS divergence has zero offset at w=1, applying smooth suppression of large deviations to balance alignment performance and generation diversity.
summary_en.experiments: Across controlled AR T2I GRPO runs with identical sampling, advantage calculation, and training schedules, JS regularization matches reverse KL on human preference alignment scores while delivering substantially higher output diversity. Ablation studies confirm observed optimization dynamics align with theoretical predictions of gradient shaping effects.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in ~15 minutes. Focus on Section 3's derivation of gradient shaping under different f-divergences, particularly the comparative analysis of f'(w) curves across variants. The experimental section can be scanned briefly for the main quality-diversity tradeoff results without diving into implementation details.

recommendation.zh: 读理论推导和 Janus-7B ablation 即可；它对离散生成 RL 的 KL 选择有用，但先别外推到文本 RLVR。
recommendation.en: Read the derivation and Janus-7B ablations; useful for KL choice in discrete generative RL, but do not directly extrapolate it to text RLVR.

paper.title: Reasoning as Intersection: Consensus-Frame Alignment for Visual Focus in Video-MLLMs
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning has improved the reasoning ability of large language models, but applying outcome-only rewards to video multimodal large language models (Video-MLLMs) provides limited guidance on which visual evidence should support the answer. Inspired by multisensory integration, where consistent cues can enhance the salience and reliability of perceptual estimates, we introduce Consensus Frame GRPO (CF-GRPO), a temporal-annotation-free process-level reward framework for evidence-aware

summary.core_problem: 视频多模态大模型采用纯结果奖励的RL训练时，无法指导模型选择支撑答案的视觉证据，而现有过程级奖励依赖昂贵的人工时序标注。
summary.importance: 提出无需人工时序标注的视频MLLM过程级RL奖励框架，属于多模态对齐方法的增量改进。
summary.technical_approach: 提出CF-GRPO框架，从视频内在信号（时序覆盖、场景切换、查询条件视觉相关性）构造共识帧先验，从模型视觉与响应表示计算帧使用分数，通过二者对齐构造共识帧奖励，结合显著性稀疏聚合与分布锐化提供高对比度奖励信号。
summary.experiments: 在多个视频推理基准上验证，相比纯结果奖励的GRPO基线提升视频推理性能，全程无需人工时序标注。

summary_en.core_problem: Outcome-only RL rewards for video-MLLMs provide no guidance on selecting answer-supporting visual evidence, while existing process-level rewards rely on expensive human temporal annotations.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a temporal-annotation-free process-level reward framework for video-MLLM RL training, representing an incremental improvement in multimodal alignment methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: CF-GRPO constructs a consensus frame prior from intrinsic video signals (temporal coverage, scene transitions, query-conditioned visual relevance), computes model-side frame-use scores from visual and response representations, and aligns the two to form the Consensus Frame Reward, augmented with salience-aware sparse aggregation and distribution sharpening for high-contrast training signals.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on multiple video reasoning benchmarks, showing consistent improvements over outcome-only GRPO baselines without requiring any human temporal annotations.

recommendation.zh: 视频MLLM特化的GRPO奖励设计，无通用LLM场景验证，了解核心思路即可，无需细读正文
recommendation.en: A video-MLLM-specific GRPO reward design without validation on general LLM setups; note the core idea but no deep read needed.

paper.title: LiveStarPro: Proactive Streaming Video Understanding with Hierarchical Memory for Long-Horizon Streams
paper.abstract: Despite the remarkable progress of Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs), current online architectures still struggle to simultaneously process continuous video streams, decide autonomously when to respond, and preserve long-horizon contextual memory. These obstacles undermine real-time responsiveness and cause severe forgetting throughout prolonged interactions. In this work, we introduce LiveStarPro, a live streaming assistant that is designed for proactive video understanding over long-hor

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是在线 Video-LLM 的三个耦合难题：持续视频流输入下何时该说话、长时程上下文如何保留、以及如何在真实 streaming 场景里训练和评测。作者认为现有方法常把“沉默”当成一个需要预测的 EOS 目标，这会带来严重类别不平衡、相邻帧监督冲突、与预训练语义目标不一致、以及高频 EOS 污染词表分布等问题。同时，常见 sliding window 记忆机制会在长视频里快速遗忘远处事件，导致模型无法回答跨长时间跨度的问题。论文的核心目标不是离线视频理解，而是构建一个始终在线、能主动决定响应时机、并能跨长时程检索历史信息的 streaming assistant。

summary.technical_approach:

summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合带着问题读。先看 Introduction，作者对 EOS-based streaming 范式的四点批评讲得比较具体，能快速判断你是否认同它的问题定义。然后直接找方法部分里 SVeD 的判定机制：它到底验证什么、perplexity 是对哪个分布算的、阈值是否需要额外校准。接着看 hierarchical memory 的结构图和检索流程，重点判断它是工程缓存，还是有明确的长期状态抽象。实验部分优先看 response timing、long-horizon QA、latency/compute 三类表。作为 skim 论文，预计 20 到 35 分钟足够形成判断。如果你的关注点是基座预训练，只需要吸收两件事：不要轻易把控制信号做成高频词表目标；长时程多模态系统需要显式 memory interface，而不是单靠扩大上下文窗。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses three coupled problems in online Video-LLMs: deciding when to respond in a continuous stream, preserving useful context over long horizons, and training/evaluating models for realistic streaming settings. The authors argue that many prior systems formulate silence as an EOS prediction problem, which creates severe class imbalance, contradictory supervision on adjacent frames, mismatch with semantic pretraining objectives, and contamination of the token distribution by an overused control token. At the same time, standard sliding-window memory quickly forgets distant events, making long-horizon questions hard or impossible to answer. The goal is therefore not offline video QA, but an always-on streaming assistant that can proactively respond at the right time and retrieve relevant history over long durations.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to core LLM pretraining is limited, because the paper is mainly about online video understanding and inference-time system design rather than pretraining objectives, data mixtures, or optimization dynamics. Still, two ideas are useful. First, the paper makes a clean objective-design argument: silence should not be learned as a semantic token target, but derived from confidence verification. That is a broader lesson about alignment between training targets and the model’s native generative distribution, especially for multimodal systems with control signals. Second, the hierarchical memory design is an inference-side solution, but it points to a real open question for long-video and long-audio foundation models: how to expose an explicit memory interface instead of relying only on larger context windows. Overall, this is better viewed as an online VLM/agent systems paper than a pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach:
LiveStarPro is built from three components, with the first two clearly described in the provided text. The first is SVeD, Streaming Verification Decoding. Instead of training the model to emit EOS or silence decisions frame by frame, SVeD uses single-pass perplexity verification to determine whether the current moment warrants a response. The conceptual move is important: silence becomes a derived state rather than a supervised prediction target. This avoids the optimization pathologies of EOS-heavy training while keeping the model focused on meaningful video-language generation.

The second component is a hierarchical memory mechanism for long-horizon streams. The paper criticizes pure sliding-window approaches on three grounds: context saturation is inevitable, FIFO eviction destroys distant but important history, and evicted information becomes unrecoverable. LiveStarPro therefore introduces layered memory with explicit retrieval, separating recent context from longer-term stored information so that the system can recall events far outside the active window. The excerpt does not expose the full memory schema, but the intended design is clear: not all frames should remain in the prompt; some should be compressed, indexed, and retrievable.

The third component appears to be broader training/evaluation support for proactive streaming assistants. The introduction argues that current datasets are too concentrated in egocentric video and that current benchmarks overemphasize synchronous VQA while under-covering live narration, temporal grounding, and multi-turn interaction. The full paper likely includes new data and benchmark assets to support these settings, though the provided text stops before the details.
summary_en.experiments:
From the available content, the experimental agenda is clear even though the numbers are missing. The paper is positioned against EOS-based online Video-LLM systems such as VideoLLM-online, VideoLLM-MoD, and LION-FS. The expected comparisons are about response timing quality, long-horizon memory retention, and broader online video understanding tasks. The key claim is that verification-based response triggering is better aligned with the model’s semantics than explicit silence prediction, and that hierarchical memory improves access to distant events.

The excerpt does not contain result tables, metrics, model sizes, or training scales, so no precise figures should be stated. When reading the full paper, four checks matter most. First, does SVeD actually improve the precision/recall trade-off of response timing, or does it simply become more conservative? Second, how does performance degrade as the temporal horizon grows, and does the memory system flatten that curve? Third, does the method generalize beyond egocentric data to more diverse streaming domains? Fourth, what is the latency and compute overhead, since a streaming assistant is only useful if the timing gains do not come with prohibitive runtime cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read this one with a narrow objective. Start from the Introduction, where the critique of EOS-based streaming is concrete and easy to evaluate. Then jump to the SVeD method details: what exactly is being verified, how perplexity is computed, and whether thresholding requires extra calibration. After that, inspect the hierarchical memory design and retrieval path. The main question is whether it is just an engineering cache or a more principled long-term state interface. In experiments, prioritize response-timing metrics, long-horizon QA or event-recall results, and latency/compute tables. As a skim paper, 20–35 minutes should be enough. If your main interest is foundation-model pretraining, the two takeaways are simple: avoid turning non-semantic control states into dominant token targets, and do not expect larger context windows alone to solve long-horizon multimodal memory.

recommendation.zh: 对做流式多模态的人可读，重点看SVeD和SCAM；如果这两块实验干净，说明“何时说话”可以从生成目标里顺手学出来，而不必额外造token。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you work on streaming multimodal models: focus on SVeD and SCAM; if those ablations are clean, they suggest response timing can be learned from the generation objective rather than hard-coded with extra tokens.

summary.core_problem: 文本生成视频的奖励模型存在两个结构性缺陷：未逐条验证提示词所有条件，且判断依据的视觉证据隐式存在于自由推理中，导致细粒度语义对齐差。
summary.importance: 方法创新，将结构化场景图引入奖励模型的推理过程，属于多模态生成后训练的对齐方法研究。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SG-PVR视频奖励模型：先用规划模块将提示词分解为原子断言，再从视频中提取包含实体、属性与时序关系的时空场景图作为持久结构化参考，逐条断言结合视频与场景图进行显式验证。
summary.experiments: 在文本到视频的语义对齐评测上取得强性能，相比无结构化 grounding 的推理式奖励模型在细粒度条件满足率上有明显提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Text-to-video reward models suffer two structural flaws: they do not systematically verify every prompt condition, and visual evidence for judgments remains implicit in free-form reasoning, hurting fine-grained semantic alignment.
summary_en.importance: A methodological contribution that injects structured scene graphs into reward model reasoning, belonging to multimodal generation alignment and post-training research.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes SG-PVR: a plan module first decomposes the prompt into atomic claims; a spatio-temporal scene graph encoding entities, attributes, and temporally-grounded relations is extracted from the video as a persistent structured reference; each claim is explicitly verified against both the video and the scene graph.
summary_en.experiments: Achieves strong semantic alignment performance on T2V benchmarks, with measurable gains in fine-grained prompt condition satisfaction over reasoning-based reward models without structured grounding.

recommendation.zh: 多模态奖励模型的结构化grounding思路，对设计RLHF/RLVR的verifier有弱参考，看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: The structured grounding idea for multimodal reward models offers weak reference for RLHF/RLVR verifier design; read the method section only.

summary.core_problem: 解决跨模态知识蒸馏依赖成对多模态数据的问题，即教师和学生分别工作在不同模态时，如何在无配对样本下传递知识。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies cross-modal knowledge distillation when teacher and student operate on different modalities but paired multimodal data are unavailable.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly methodological and theoretical: it decomposes unpaired CMKD into feature alignment and label alignment, which is relevant to multimodal alignment but only indirectly tied to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It derives a distributional relationship between teacher and student models across modalities, identifies representation-level and prediction-level alignment terms, and builds an algorithmic framework around these quantities with theoretical guarantees.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical improvements; it only indicates settings such as image teachers guiding text or audio students.

recommendation.zh: 可把 feature/label alignment 当作无配对 VLM 对齐的弱信号；若实验规模小，就只读理论假设。
recommendation.en: Treat the feature/label-alignment decomposition as a weak signal for unpaired VLM alignment; if experiments are small, read only the assumptions.

summary.core_problem: 现有文本到音乐生成系统依赖大规模私有数据和工业级算力，小数据场景下无法有效利用低对齐质量的样本。
summary.importance: 提出分数感知的训练范式，属于小数据下多模态生成的方法创新，实现了低质量样本的有效复用。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing text-to-music generation systems rely on large-scale proprietary datasets and industrial compute, and cannot effectively utilize low-alignment samples in low-data regimes.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a score-aware training paradigm, a methodological innovation for multimodal generation under limited data that enables effective reuse of low-quality samples.

recommendation.en: The idea of staged scheduling and reuse of low-quality samples can be referenced for hierarchical utilization of pretraining data, no need to read the full text.

summary.core_problem: 解决 LVLM 在 meme 和讽刺图文理解中容易停留在字面图像描述、无法稳定识别作者真实交际意图的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态理解方法：把 meme 理解拆成 literal content 和 pragmatic intent 两个信号，并在表示、输出和目标函数层面显式分离。它不是通用 VLM 预训练工作，但对多模态对齐中“表层内容污染语义意图”的问题有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Intent Projection 框架，在单一 LVLM backbone 内做三层处理：表示层用正交投影模块移除融合图文表示中的主导单模态方向，保留 pragmatic residual；用 surface-real affect classifier 给 decoder 一个离散极性差异标签；输出层要求模型生成结构化推理链；目标层用 contrastive reward 惩罚字面解释和真实意图的混淆。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据规模、baseline 名称或数值提升。可确认实验对象是 meme / sarcastic post 理解任务，目标是减少 LVLM 对表层视觉内容的过度依赖。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 The Chinese University of Hong Kong、Huawei 和 Central China Normal University；Yulan He 是 NLP 领域知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles LVLM failures on memes and sarcastic posts, where models describe literal visual content instead of recovering the author’s pragmatic intent.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal understanding method that explicitly decomposes literal content and pragmatic intent at the representation, output, and objective levels. It is not a general VLM pretraining paper, but it is relevant to surface-form contamination in multimodal alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Intent Projection operates inside a single LVLM backbone. At the representation level, an orthogonal projection module removes dominant unimodal directions from fused image-text representations and keeps a pragmatic residual. A surface-real affect classifier provides a discrete polarity-gap tag to the decoder. At the output level, the model externalizes a structured reasoning chain. At the objective level, a contrastive reward penalizes confusion between literal reading and intended meaning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, dataset sizes, baseline names, or numeric gains. The evaluation target is meme and sarcastic-post understanding, with the goal of reducing over-reliance on surface visual content.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Huawei, and Central China Normal University. Yulan He is a well-known NLP researcher.
