paper.title: Beyond 3D VQAs: Injecting 3D Spatial Priors into Vision-Language Models for Enhanced Geometric Reasoning
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) often struggle with robust 3D spatial reasoning. Prevailing methods that rely on fine-tuning with 3D visual question-answering (VQA) datasets may overfit dataset-specific biases, while integrating specialized 3D visual encoders is often inflexible and cumbersome. In this paper, we argue that genuine spatial understanding should emerge from learning fundamental geometric priors, not only from high-level VQA supervision. We propose GASP (Geometric-Aware Spatial Priors

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM的3D空间推理能力薄弱，主流改进方案存在明显缺陷：在3D VQA数据集上微调容易过拟合数据集特有偏差，域外泛化性差；集成专用3D视觉编码器会增加模型大小和推理延迟，且编码器通常只能冻结使用，与标准VLM训练流程不兼容，对齐难度高。
summary.importance: 该工作验证了无需依赖3D VQA标注或专用3D编码器，直接在VLM训练阶段注入底层几何先验即可提升空间推理能力，且提升具备更好的泛化性。这为VLM预训练中引入多模态结构化先验提供了新思路，整个方案不会改变推理阶段的模型结构和计算开销。
summary.technical_approach: 提出GASP（几何感知空间先验）框架，在VLM的LLM Transformer所有层插入轻量对应头作为深度监督信号。训练阶段利用大规模视频场景的真实几何标注优化双目标：一是跨帧点对应数据的对比学习目标，让模型学习物体恒常性，获得视角不变的2D表示；二是深度一致性损失，用真实深度图做正则，解决前景背景匹配混淆带来的3D歧义。对应头仅在训练阶段激活，推理时完全移除，不会增加额外推理开销。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B、LLaVA-NeXT-Video-7B等VLM上验证，GASP将层间峰值对应匹配准确率从低于5%提升至70%以上，时间鲁棒性保持在85%以上，基线模型始终低于5%。在未使用任何3D VQA数据训练的情况下，下游空间推理任务中，相机姿态估计在All-Angles基准提升18.2%，物体计数在VSI-Bench提升29.0%，多视角推理在BLINK基准提升15.0%，通用视频QA性能仅出现微小波动。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看Introduction部分对现有两类方案缺陷的分析，耗时约5分钟；再重点了解GASP框架的核心设计，重点理解采用跨帧对应和深度监督的动机，以及训练后移除对应头的设计逻辑，无需深入抠损失函数的具体实现；最后浏览实验部分的核心性能提升数据即可，总阅读时间约15分钟。重点关注无需3D VQA标注、不增加推理开销两个核心优势。

summary_en.core_problem: Current vision-language models (VLMs) have weak 3D spatial reasoning capability, and mainstream improvement schemes have notable limitations: fine-tuning on 3D VQA datasets easily overfits to dataset-specific biases and leads to poor out-of-domain generalization, while integrating dedicated 3D visual encoders increases model size and inference latency, and the encoders usually have to be used with frozen weights which is incompatible with standard VLM training pipelines and brings high alignment difficulty.
summary_en.importance: This work verifies that injecting low-level geometric priors directly during VLM training can improve spatial reasoning capability without relying on 3D VQA annotations or dedicated 3D encoders, and the improvement has better generalization. It provides a new direction for introducing structured multimodal priors in VLM pre-training, with no change to model structure or computational overhead during inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed GASP (Geometric-Aware Spatial Priors) framework inserts a lightweight correspondence head across all layers of the VLM's LLM Transformer as a deep supervision signal. During training, it optimizes a dual objective using ground-truth geometric annotations from large-scale video scenes: first, a contrastive learning objective on cross-frame point correspondence data to teach the model object constancy and obtain view-invariant 2D representations; second, a depth consistency loss that uses ground-truth depth maps as a regularizer to resolve 3D ambiguity from foreground-background matching confusion. The correspondence head is only active during training and is completely removed at inference, adding no extra overhead.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on VLMs including Qwen2.5-VL-7B and LLaVA-NeXT-Video-7B, GASP lifts peak layer-wise correspondence matching accuracy from below 5% to over 70%, and maintains temporal robustness above 85%, while baselines stay below 5%. Trained without any 3D VQA data, the model achieves +18.2% improvement on camera pose estimation on All-Angles Bench, +29.0% on object counting on VSI-Bench, +15.0% on multi-view reasoning on BLINK benchmark, with only minor fluctuation in general video QA performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, first read the analysis of limitations of existing two schemes in the Introduction, which takes about 5 minutes. Then focus on the core design of the GASP framework, especially the motivation for using cross-frame correspondence and depth supervision, and the design logic of removing the correspondence head after training. No need to dig into the specific implementation of loss functions. Finally browse the core performance improvement data in the experiment section, with total reading time of about 15 minutes. Focus on the two core advantages: no requirement for 3D VQA annotations and no additional inference overhead.

recommendation.zh: 值得看方法图和损失定义；它把 3D 能力从问答数据问题改写成层内几何监督，prior 比套 VQA 更干净。
recommendation.en: Read the method figure and losses: it reframes 3D ability as layer-wise geometric supervision rather than more VQA data, which is a cleaner prior.

paper.title: Rethinking Visual Neglect: Steering via Context-Preference for MLLM Hallucination Mitigation
paper.abstract: Object hallucination remains a primary obstacle to the reliable deployment of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Current inference-time mitigation methods mainly assume hallucinations stem from visual neglect, steering models to enhance visual reliance. In contrast, our systematic interventions on multiple MLLMs show that pushing toward more visual reliance may exacerbate hallucinations on some models, while less may mitigate hallucinations. This result suggests that attributing hallucina

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 MLLM 物体幻觉的推理时干预问题。它质疑一个常见假设：幻觉主要来自模型忽视视觉输入，因此只要把模型推向更依赖图像就能缓解幻觉。作者用干预实验说明，这个假设不稳定；在不同模型、不同语义轴上，增强视觉依赖有时反而会增加幻觉。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在训练 recipe，而在机制分析。它把“视觉依赖”拆成两个可观测的竞争关系：视觉上下文对参数知识，视觉上下文对文本上下文。这对理解多模态预训练后的内部偏好有帮助，尤其是为什么同样的视觉增强策略在 LLaVA、Qwen-VL 等模型上表现不同。对基座研究员更有用的是这套诊断框架，而不是幻觉缓解本身。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Context-Preference Activation Steering，简称 CAS。它先构造两类冲突样本来提取 Context Preference Vectors。第一类是反常识图像，用来提取 Visual Fidelity Vector，衡量模型在图像证据和参数知识之间更偏向哪一边。第二类是对称的图文冲突样本，用来提取 Modality Reliance Vector，衡量模型在视觉上下文和文本上下文之间的偏好。提取向量时，作者不是直接看注意力，而是读取隐藏状态中候选答案偏好的方向。推理时，CAS 在若干中间层的 MLP 输出处注入带符号的向量残差。关键点是符号需要按模型和向量类型选择，因为“往视觉方向推”并不总是有效。和 VCD、PAI、AttnReal 这类方法相比，CAS 的区别是把视觉偏好拆成两个轴，并允许不同模型有不同的有效干预方向。
summary.experiments: 摘要和正文片段给出的主要实验证据包括三点。第一，在 LLaVA-1.5 和 Qwen-VL 上，沿同一个视觉相关方向干预，幻觉曲线可能上升也可能下降，说明视觉增强不是单调有效的。第二，同一模型上，VFV 和 MRV 的最优干预符号可能相反，说明参数知识竞争和跨模态竞争是两个相对独立的行为维度。第三，同一个 CPV 在不同模型上的有效符号也可能不同，说明模型间的上下文偏好存在异质性。作者还报告 CAS 只需少量任务无关样本提取向量，在推理时单次前向即可应用，不引入额外解码轮次；并且中间层不同 layer band 对两类向量的响应差异明显。给定材料中没有提供具体 benchmark 分数、样本规模和完整消融数字，读时需要回到实验表格核对实际幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看 Figure 1，它是论文判断成立的关键：不同模型、不同 CPV、不同符号的响应是否真的不一致。然后看 3.1 的两类冲突样本构造，确认 VFV 和 MRV 是否干净地分离了参数知识、文本上下文和视觉上下文。3.2 只需把注入位置、注入强度、符号选择流程看清楚。实验部分建议重点看层位置消融、符号消融、生成质量退化分析，以及和 VCD/PAI/AttnReal 的延迟与重复退化对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies inference-time mitigation of object hallucination in multimodal LLMs. Its main claim is that the common “hallucination equals visual neglect” explanation is under-specified. Pushing a model toward stronger visual reliance can help in some cases, but can also make hallucination worse, depending on the model and on which internal preference axis is being steered.
summary_en.importance: The value for foundation-model research is mostly diagnostic rather than algorithmic. The paper separates visual preference into two competitions: image evidence versus parametric knowledge, and image context versus textual context. This is a useful lens for analyzing why visually grounded interventions transfer poorly across MLLM families such as LLaVA and Qwen-VL. The activation-steering method is less important than the measurement protocol that exposes heterogeneous context preferences after multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method is Context-Preference Activation Steering, or CAS. It first builds two conflict-based sample sets. Counterfactual images that violate commonsense are used to derive a Visual Fidelity Vector, capturing whether the model follows the image or its pretrained world knowledge. Symmetric image-text conflict pairs are used to derive a Modality Reliance Vector, capturing whether the model follows visual context or textual context. The vectors are obtained from hidden-state preferences over candidate answers, rather than from attention weights. At inference time, signed residuals of these vectors are injected into MLP outputs in a small number of middle layers. The sign is model-specific and vector-specific, which is the central departure from earlier methods such as VCD, PAI, and AttnReal that generally assume more visual dependence is the right direction.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content highlights three empirical findings. On LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen-VL, steering toward stronger visual context can either reduce or increase hallucination. Within the same model, the best signs for the Visual Fidelity Vector and the Modality Reliance Vector can be opposite, suggesting that the two axes are behaviorally distinct. For the same vector, the effective sign can differ across base models, showing nontrivial model heterogeneity. CAS is reported to use only a small task-irrelevant calibration set, to run in a single forward pass, and to avoid extra decoding latency. The text also mentions layer-band sensitivity for the two vectors. Exact benchmark scores, calibration-set size, and ablation numbers are not present in the supplied excerpt, so the quantitative strength of the method should be checked in the tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with Figure 1, because the paper’s main argument depends on the non-monotonic and model-dependent steering curves. Then read Section 3.1 carefully to see whether the two conflict datasets really isolate parametric knowledge, text context, and visual evidence. Section 3.2 is mainly needed for the injection layer, sign selection, and steering-strength details. In the experiments, focus on sign ablations, layer ablations, generation-quality checks, and comparisons with VCD, PAI, and AttnReal in both hallucination reduction and decoding behavior.

recommendation.zh: 推翻了幻觉仅源于视觉不足的单一归因，上下文偏好激活转向的方法可复用至多模态对齐实验，重点看§2干预实验
recommendation.en: Overturns the single attribution of hallucination to visual insufficiency, the context-preference activation steering method can be reused in multimodal alignment experiments, focus on §2 intervention results

paper.title: Real Images, Worse Judgments: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Concreteness and Imagery
paper.abstract: Visual inputs are often assumed to improve language understanding in multimodal models. We examine this assumption by asking whether vision-language models (VLMs) can distinguish useful visual evidence from incidental image context in lexical judgments. We use human concreteness and imagery ratings because they span words with varying expected visual relevance, from abstract and low-imagery words to concrete and high-imagery words. We find that real-image contexts do not yield consistent gains a

summary.core_problem: 论文检验一个很具体的问题：VLM 在做词汇层面的 concreteness 和 imagery 判断时，能否把图像当作可选证据，而不是把任意真实图片都当成目标词属性的直接依据。任务要求判断的是“词”本身，不是图片内容；因此真实图片在很多情况下只是干扰上下文。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值不在于提出新模型，而在于给 VLM 预训练和指令微调暴露了一个训练信号问题：多模态模型未必学会了“视觉证据何时相关”。如果加入真实图像反而降低与人类词汇判断的一致性，说明视觉条件化会改变语言表征和决策路径。对基座研究的启发是，图文预训练不能只优化图像-文本对齐和问答准确率，还需要加入 relevance gating、反事实图像、无关图像鲁棒性等训练或评测信号。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是控制目标词和文本任务不变，只改变视觉上下文。作者比较无图输入、白图、随机噪声图，以及从 ImageNet 和 Wikimedia Commons 检索到的真实图片。模型被要求按原始人类评分量表给单词打分：concreteness 使用 MT40k 的 1–5 分，imagery 使用 CP2004B 的 1–7 分。评估模型包括文本模型 LLaMA 2、Mistral、Qwen2.5，以及 VLM LLaVA 1.5、InternVL3、Pixtral、Qwen2.5-VL、Gemma 3，且均为 instruction-tuned。作者还使用 probing、canonical correlation analysis 和 attribution case study 分析真实图片如何引起表征偏移，并测试一个推理时 prompting 干预，让模型更明确地区分词汇判断和图片内容。
summary.experiments: 实验包含 2,082 个 MT40k 单词和 2,108 个 CP2004B 单词；每个任务使用 5 个 prompt 模板并对可解析数值预测取平均，用 RMSE 衡量模型预测与人类评分的一致性。主要结果是：真实图片上下文没有带来稳定收益，很多情况下会提高 RMSE；负面影响在抽象词和低 imagery 词上更明显，因为这些词本来就不应该由某张图片决定。白图和噪声图用于区分“有视觉输入”与“真实图片语义内容”的影响。作者还做了匹配的人类实验，发现人类评分者在同样的检索图片条件下没有出现类似退化，说明退化主要来自模型对视觉上下文的使用方式。推理时提示模型关注词本身可以缓解部分退化，但不能完全消除。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看实验设置中视觉条件的构造方式、按抽象/具体和 low/high imagery 分组的 RMSE 表格，以及 representation analysis 部分。最值得看的是作者如何把“真实图片可能有帮助”转化成“真实图片是否被错误当作证据”的反事实式评测。若关注 VLM 预训练，可重点看 probing、CCA 和 attribution 案例，它们比总分更能说明视觉 token 对语言判断路径的扰动。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether VLMs can treat visual input as conditional evidence rather than as a default source of truth. The task is lexical: rate the concreteness or imageability of a word. A retrieved real image is often incidental, especially for abstract or low-imageability words, and should not determine the rating.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is diagnostic. It shows that multimodal conditioning can degrade a language judgment that should remain stable under irrelevant visual context. For pretraining, this points to a missing signal in common image-text objectives: models learn to use images, but not reliably when to ignore them. This has direct implications for multimodal data design, counterfactual negative examples, and relevance-aware visual grounding objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study holds the target word and instruction fixed while varying the visual context: no image, a white image, random noise, and real images retrieved from ImageNet or Wikimedia Commons. Models are asked to produce numeric ratings on the original human scales: 1–5 for concreteness in MT40k and 1–7 for imagery in CP2004B. The evaluated models include instruction-tuned text-only LLaMA 2, Mistral, and Qwen2.5, plus LLaVA 1.5, InternVL3, Pixtral, Qwen2.5-VL, and Gemma 3. The analysis combines RMSE against human ratings with probing, canonical correlation analysis, attribution examples, and a simple prompting intervention that tells the model to focus on the word rather than the image.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses 2,082 single-word entries from MT40k and 2,108 from CP2004B. Five prompt templates are used per task, and parsed numeric predictions are averaged to reduce template variance. Real-image contexts do not produce consistent gains and often worsen alignment with human ratings. The degradation is strongest for abstract and low-imageability words, where the image is least relevant to the requested judgment. White and noise controls help separate the effect of visual input from the semantic content of natural images. A matched human study does not show the same degradation, suggesting that the failure is model-specific rather than an unavoidable ambiguity in the task. Prompting can reduce some of the harm, but it is not a complete fix.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the visual-context construction, the RMSE breakdowns by abstract/concrete and low/high imagery groups, and the representation analysis. The most useful part for multimodal pretraining is the framing: irrelevant real images are used as a controlled test of whether the model can gate visual evidence. The CCA, probing, and attribution sections are more informative than aggregate accuracy because they show how visual context shifts language-side representations.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了 VLM 在处理图文输入时，视觉信息可能成为干扰项（尤其是抽象概念），对多模态预训练中图文对齐 loss 的设计有启发，值得看 probing 分析部分。
recommendation.en: Reveals that visual information can act as a distractor in VLMs (especially for abstract concepts), offering insights for designing image-text alignment losses in multimodal pretraining; the probing analysis is worth reading.

paper.title: Reasoning Matters: Mitigate Hallucination in Multimodal Large Reasoning Models via Reasoning-Conditioned Preference Optimization
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Reasoning Models introduce the reasoning paradigm, demonstrating strong capabilities on complex vision-language tasks. However, they still suffer from severe hallucinations. Existing training-based methods typically mitigate hallucinations through response-level direct preference optimization (DPO), where the Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and the final answer are treated as a monolithic output and optimized jointly. We reveal that this formulation performs similarly to answer-only opti

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是多模态推理模型中的 CoT 幻觉问题。现有 DPO 类方法通常把推理链和最终答案拼成一个完整 response 做偏好优化，但训练信号容易被最终答案主导，导致中间推理链没有得到足够约束。论文的核心问题是：如何直接优化“推理链是否支持正确答案”，而不是只优化完整回答的偏好。
summary.importance: 这篇论文属于 post-training 方法，对预训练研究的间接价值在于训练信号设计。它指出在带 CoT 的模型中，response-level preference 可能学习到 answer-level shortcut：答案变好，但推理过程仍可能包含视觉不支持的对象、关系或属性。对基座研究员有用的地方是，它把中间推理作为条件变量来建模，强调训练目标需要区分“最终答案正确”和“生成该答案的中间证据可靠”。这个思路可迁移到文本推理、代码执行轨迹、工具调用轨迹和 RL 数据构造中。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Reasoning-Conditioned DPO，简称 RC-DPO。标准 response-level DPO 比较的是完整输出，即 CoT 加答案的整体优劣；RC-DPO 改成在同一个多模态输入和同一个 preferred answer 下，比较不同 CoT 条件带来的答案似然差异。正向 CoT 是视觉 grounded、逻辑有效的推理链；负向 CoT 是幻觉或被破坏的推理链。这样优化目标隔离了答案本身的影响，让模型学习“什么样的 CoT 更能支持正确答案”。数据构造上，论文用 MCTS 搜索高质量正向推理链，用 attention-guided CoT token pruning 构造负向链：删除与视觉证据强相关的 CoT token，使推理链缺失关键视觉依据或变得不可靠。最终训练通常结合 response-level preference 和 reasoning-conditioned preference。
summary.experiments: 论文先做动机实验：把 OPA-DPO 的训练动态按 CoT span 和 answer span 拆开看，发现 policy-reference preference gap 在答案段增长更快；answer-only 变体的 CHAIR_S 接近 OPA-DPO，说明粗粒度 DPO 的收益很大一部分来自答案级偏好学习。推理时的分解分析还显示，幻觉不仅出现在最终答案，也会出现在 CoT，并可能向答案传播。主实验覆盖 4 个多模态大推理模型和 9 个 benchmark，报告 RC-DPO 能同时降低幻觉并提升多模态推理表现。给定内容没有提供完整数值表，因此不补写具体百分比。关键消融应关注三点：仅 response-level DPO、仅 answer-level DPO、加入 reasoning-conditioned term 后的差异；MCTS 正样本质量；attention-guided pruning 相比随机扰动的效果。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30 分钟。优先看 Observation and Motivation，尤其是 Figure 2 中 answer span 与 CoT span 优化速度不同、answer-only 接近 OPA-DPO 的证据。然后看 RC-DPO 目标函数推导，确认它如何固定 preferred answer 并只改变 CoT condition。数据构造部分也值得看，尤其是 MCTS 正样本搜索和 attention-guided negative construction。实验部分重点读 hallucination benchmark、CoT/answer 分段评估和消融表。若只关心预训练启发，可以跳过具体多模态 benchmark 细节，重点看训练信号如何避免答案捷径。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets hallucinations in multimodal large reasoning models, especially hallucinations that appear inside the chain of thought and then propagate to the final answer. Existing DPO-style methods usually optimize the concatenation of CoT and answer as one response. The paper argues that this coarse objective mainly learns answer-level preferences and leaves the reasoning chain under-supervised.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training paper, but it is relevant to pretraining researchers because it studies the granularity of learning signals. The main lesson is that correct final answers are not enough when the model is trained to generate intermediate reasoning. A preference objective can improve answers while still allowing unsupported intermediate claims. The same issue appears in text reasoning, code execution traces, tool-use trajectories, and synthetic RL data: training should distinguish whether the intermediate trajectory actually supports the final outcome.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method is Reasoning-Conditioned Direct Preference Optimization, or RC-DPO. Instead of comparing two full responses, RC-DPO fixes the multimodal input and the preferred answer, then contrasts the likelihood of that same answer under different CoT conditions. A visually grounded and logically valid CoT should make the preferred answer more likely than a hallucinated or corrupted CoT. This controlled comparison isolates the effect of the reasoning chain from the answer itself. For data construction, the paper uses MCTS to search for high-quality positive reasoning chains, and attention-guided CoT token pruning to create negative chains by removing visually salient reasoning tokens. The final training combines the usual response-level preference signal with this reasoning-conditioned preference term.
summary_en.experiments: The motivation experiments decompose DPO training by CoT and answer spans. The policy-reference preference gap grows faster on the answer segment, and an answer-only variant achieves CHAIR_S close to OPA-DPO, supporting the claim that response-level DPO tends to learn answer-level shortcuts. The paper also evaluates hallucinations separately in CoT and final answers, showing that hallucinated intermediate claims are a real source of final-answer errors. The main experiments cover four multimodal reasoning models and nine benchmarks, with reported gains in hallucination reduction and multimodal reasoning. Exact numeric improvements are not available in the provided content. The most informative ablations are the comparison against response-level DPO, answer-only optimization, and variants of positive/negative CoT construction.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 minutes. Start with the Observation and Motivation section, especially the figure that compares optimization dynamics for CoT spans and answer spans. Then read the RC-DPO derivation to see how the preferred answer is held fixed while the CoT condition changes. The data-generation section is important because the method depends on the quality of positive CoTs and the usefulness of attention-guided negative pruning. In the experiments, focus on segmented CoT-versus-answer hallucination evaluation and the ablation tables. Readers interested mainly in pretraining signals can spend less time on individual multimodal benchmark details.

recommendation.zh: 做DPO/推理对齐的研究员可重点看§3的方法推导，CoT与答案解耦的思路可迁移到文本基座的推理对齐训练
recommendation.en: Researchers working on DPO/reasoning alignment can focus on §3 method derivation; the CoT-answer decoupling idea is transferable to text LLM reasoning alignment training.

paper.title: LongAV-Compass: Towards Unified Evaluation of Minute-Scale Audio-Visual Generation Across T2AV, I2AV, and V2AV
paper.abstract: Audio-visual generation is rapidly advancing from short clips to minute-long content, while existing evaluation protocols remain largely confined to short-form settings. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on 5--10 second text-conditioned generation and rarely support unified evaluation across text, image, and video conditioning modalities. Moreover, they provide limited insight into how identity consistency, narrative coherence, and audio-visual alignment degrade over extended temporal horizons

summary.core_problem: 音视频生成正在从 5–10 秒短片走向分钟级内容，但评测协议仍主要面向短时文本条件生成，难以衡量长时身份一致性、叙事连贯性和音画同步退化。
summary.importance: 这是长时音视频生成 benchmark 贡献，覆盖 T2AV、I2AV、V2AV 三种条件形式。对统一多模态生成预训练的价值在于提供长时间轴上的失败模式定义和评价维度，而不是提出训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: LongAV-Compass 构建 284 个精选测试用例，按应用场景和生成复杂度组织，覆盖文本到音视频、图像到音视频、视频到音视频。评测框架结合 taxonomy-guided 构造、MLLM-assisted assessment，以及感知指标和多模态一致性指标。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出 284 个测试用例，并说明用于分钟级音视频生成的统一评估；未披露被测模型、评分细则、人工一致性或模型排名结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Audio-visual generation is moving from short clips to minute-scale content, while evaluation remains focused on short text-conditioned generation and misses long-horizon degradation in identity, narrative, and audio-visual alignment.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark contribution for long-form audio-visual generation across T2AV, I2AV, and V2AV. For unified multimodal pretraining, its value is in defining long-horizon failure modes and evaluation axes, not in training methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: LongAV-Compass contains 284 curated test cases organized by application scenario and generation complexity. It combines taxonomy-guided benchmark construction with a unified evaluation framework using MLLM-assisted assessment, perceptual metrics, and multimodal alignment metrics.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 284 test cases for minute-scale audio-visual generation. It does not provide evaluated model names, scoring rubrics, human agreement numbers, or leaderboard results.

recommendation.zh: 作为长时多模态生成 eval 备查即可；真正有用的是失败维度 taxonomy，不是 284 条样例本身。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a long-form multimodal generation eval reference; the useful part is the failure taxonomy, not the 284 cases themselves.

paper.title: What Semantics Survive the Connector? Diagnosing VLM-to-DiT Alignment in Video Editing
paper.abstract: Flow matching based video generative models have been increasingly relying on prepended Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to handle complex, instruction-based video editing. The prevailing assumption underlying this paradigm is that a connector module can seamlessly align the VLM's rich multi-modal reasoning with the original text embedding space of DiTs. However, we hypothesize that this alignment acts as a severe semantic bottleneck, degrading fine-grained structural variables. Verifying this is c

summary.core_problem: 基于流匹配的视频生成模型普遍依赖前置VLM来处理复杂指令编辑，但连接器模块在对齐VLM与DiT文本嵌入空间时可能成为严重的语义瓶颈，导致细粒度结构信息退化。
summary.importance: 首次系统性诊断VLM-to-DiT对齐中的语义丢失问题，通过精心设计的控制数据集分离对齐失败与生成错误，属于有价值的机制分析。
summary.technical_approach: 提出TRACE-Edit诊断数据集（基于视频合成的控制数据处理流水线，聚焦关系型编辑），并设计了一套诊断协议来分析元查询（meta-query）和连接器（connector）两种设计方案。
summary.experiments: 在TRACE-Edit数据集上对现有视频编辑模型进行诊断评估，量化了VLM语义经过连接器后的丢失程度，识别出元查询和连接器设计中的具体缺陷。
summary.authors_note: 复旦大学颜伟峰团队与商汤科技，颜伟峰是多媒体领域知名学者。

summary_en.core_problem: Flow-matching video generation models rely on prepended VLMs for complex instruction editing, but the connector module aligning VLM with DiT text embeddings may act as a severe semantic bottleneck, degrading fine-grained structural information.
summary_en.importance: First systematic diagnosis of semantic loss in VLM-to-DiT alignment, disentangling alignment failures from generation errors via a controlled dataset — a valuable mechanism analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes TRACE-Edit diagnostic dataset (controlled video composition pipeline focusing on relation-based editing) and a comprehensive diagnostic protocol to analyze meta-query and connector designs.
summary_en.experiments: Diagnostic evaluation on TRACE-Edit quantifying semantic loss after the connector, identifying specific limitations in both meta-query and connector designs of existing video editing models.
summary_en.authors_note: Yanwei Fu's group at Fudan University plus SenseTime researchers; Yanwei Fu is a well-known multimedia researcher.

recommendation.zh: 多模态视频编辑领域的机制诊断，对理解VLM-DiT对齐瓶颈有一定参考价值，但与LLM预训练直接关联较弱，扫一眼摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Mechanistic diagnosis in multimodal video editing, somewhat informative for understanding VLM-DiT alignment bottlenecks but weakly connected to LLM pretraining. Glance at the abstract.

paper.title: Reducing Object Hallucination in LVLMs via Emphasizing Image-negative Tokens
paper.abstract: Object hallucination is a significant challenge that hinders the application of large vision-language models (LVLMs) in practice. We hypothesize that one possible origin of hallucination is the model's tendency to prioritize text generation over meaningful interaction with images. To explore this, we examine the generation process and categorize text tokens into three groups: image-positive, invariant, and negative, based on their visual dependence on input image tokens. Our analysis reveals tha

summary.core_problem: 解决 LVLM 在生成时过度依赖语言先验、忽视图像证据，从而产生物体幻觉的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是多模态训练信号分析和训练损失改造：作者把生成 token 按视觉依赖程度分组，指出大量 token 对图像输入不敏感，并用 token 级重加权和疑似幻觉数据过滤来抑制幻觉。
summary.technical_approach: 方法先分析生成过程中不同文本 token 对图像 token 的依赖，将其划分为 image-positive、invariant、image-negative 三类；随后根据视觉依赖程度调整训练权重，让训练更强调真正需要图像证据的 token，并移除一部分可能包含更多幻觉的训练样本。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据规模、baseline 名称和数值提升；实验重点应是 LVLM 物体幻觉评测，以及 token 重加权和数据过滤对幻觉率的影响。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Nanyang Technological University 和 Monash University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses object hallucination in LVLMs caused by generation that relies more on language priors than on visual evidence.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an analysis of multimodal training signals and a token-level loss intervention: generated tokens are grouped by visual dependence, and the authors argue that many tokens are only weakly affected by image inputs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method analyzes how much each generated text token depends on image tokens, categorizes tokens into image-positive, invariant, and image-negative groups, then reweights training losses according to visual dependence and filters training samples that may contain more hallucinated content.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, data scale, baselines, or numeric gains. The likely evaluation focuses on LVLM object hallucination benchmarks and ablations for token reweighting and data filtering.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Nanyang Technological University and Monash University.

recommendation.zh: 只看 token 视觉依赖分桶和 loss reweighting；更像 VLM 后训练修补，不改变预训练 prior，但可借鉴到多模态 loss 设计。
recommendation.en: Read the token visual-dependence grouping and loss reweighting only; it is a VLM training patch, not a pretraining-prior changer.

paper.title: ClaimDiff-RL: Fine-Grained Caption Reinforcement Learning through Visual Claim Comparison
paper.abstract: Long-form image captioning exposes a reward granularity problem in RL: captions are judged as whole sequences, while the important errors occur at the level of individual visual claims. A good dense caption should be both faithful and informative, avoiding hallucination without omitting salient details. Yet pairwise preferences, reference-based metrics, and holistic scalar rewards compress these local errors into a single sequence-level signal, obscuring the tradeoff between factuality and cover

summary.core_problem: ClaimDiff-RL 解决的是长图像描述 RL 的奖励粒度问题：整段 caption 的单一 reward 无法区分 hallucination、遗漏、正确补充细节等局部 visual claim 级错误，容易把模型推向过度保守的 under-captioning。
summary.importance: 这项工作对 VLM 后训练和 reward 设计有启发，但和基座预训练的关系较间接。主要价值在于展示一种更细粒度的多模态 reward interface：先把开放式输出拆成可验证的局部 claims，再聚合成 scalar reward。这个思路可迁移到 multimodal instruction tuning、RLHF/RLAIF、视觉推理数据合成等场景，尤其适合那些答案不是单一标签、错误分布很稀疏的任务。
summary.technical_approach: 方法保留标准 RL 所需的 scalar reward，但改变 reward 的生成方式。给定图像、actor caption 和 reference caption，multimodal judge 先枚举 actor 与 reference 之间的具体视觉差异，例如物体、属性、数量、空间关系、OCR、身份或场景细节；然后逐项回到图像中验证；最后分别给 actor side 和 reference side 标注 typed errors。reference 只作为比较锚点，不被当作完整真值。基于这些 typed error statistics，作者构造两类 reward：relative reward 比较 actor-side 与 reference-side 错误；actor-only reward 只惩罚 actor 在已发现差异上的错误。这样可以在 faithfulness 与 coverage 之间选择不同工作点。
summary.experiments: 实验结论强调 reward 粒度带来的行为差异。holistic reward 无论是否使用 reference，都容易通过减少描述内容来降低 hallucination，结果是 omission 增加、caption 变保守。ClaimDiff-RL 能更明确地区分“少说所以少错”和“覆盖更多且仍然 grounded”，因此在 factuality 与 coverage 的权衡上更可控。作者还报告该方法能保持或提升 captioning 与 VQA 能力，说明 fine-grained reward 没有简单牺牲下游视觉语言能力。提供材料中没有足够具体数字，不能判断增益量级。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15 到 20 分钟。重点看方法图和 claim-difference judge 的 prompt/输出格式，理解 actor-reference-image 三方比较如何产生 typed errors。然后看 relative reward 与 actor-only reward 的定义，它们决定了模型会偏向更保守还是更覆盖。实验部分优先看 holistic reward 导致 omission 上升的分析，以及 captioning/VQA 能力保持情况。若只关心 LLM/VLM 后训练，可跳过具体 caption 数据集细节，把注意力放在 reward decomposition 和 judge reliability 上。

summary_en.core_problem: ClaimDiff-RL addresses reward granularity in RL for long-form image captioning. A single sequence-level reward cannot tell whether a caption improved by becoming more faithful, by omitting details, or by adding correct and incorrect visual claims. This often pushes models toward conservative under-captioning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is most relevant to multimodal post-training and reward design rather than core pretraining. Its useful idea is to replace direct holistic judging with a structured verification interface: decompose open-ended outputs into local visual claims, verify those claims against the image, and only then compose a scalar reward for RL. This pattern can transfer to multimodal instruction tuning, RLAIF, visual reasoning supervision, and synthetic data filtering.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework still produces a scalar reward compatible with standard RL, but obtains it through claim-level comparison. Given an image, an actor caption, and a reference caption, a multimodal judge enumerates concrete differences between the actor and the reference, verifies each difference against the image, and assigns side-specific typed errors. The reference is used as a comparison anchor, not as exhaustive ground truth. The same judge output supports two reward compositions. A relative reward compares actor-side errors with reference-side errors. An actor-only reward removes reference-side error counts and penalizes only actor-side errors on the discovered differences. These two choices expose different points on the faithfulness-coverage frontier.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical finding is behavioral. Holistic rewards, with or without a reference, can reduce hallucination by making captions shorter and less informative, increasing omissions. ClaimDiff-RL provides a more controllable trade-off because it distinguishes unsupported actor claims from missing or correct details. The authors report that it preserves or improves captioning and VQA capability, suggesting that the finer reward does not simply overfit to a narrow caption metric. The provided material does not include enough numerical detail to assess the exact magnitude of the gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15 to 20 minutes. Focus on the method figure and the judge output schema: the important part is how actor-reference-image comparison becomes typed error statistics. Then read the definitions of the relative and actor-only rewards, since they determine the model’s operating point between faithfulness and coverage. In the experiments, look for the analysis showing omission growth under holistic rewards and the checks on captioning and VQA retention. If the interest is general VLM post-training, dataset-specific captioning details can be read lightly; judge reliability and reward decomposition are the parts worth inspecting.

recommendation.zh: 多模态 RL 的细粒度 Reward 设计，将 sequence-level 拆解为 atomic claim 级别，对 VLM post-training 的 reward model 设计有一定参考价值。
recommendation.en: Fine-grained reward design for multimodal RL, decomposing sequence-level rewards into atomic claims. Offers reference value for reward model design in VLM post-training.

paper.title: A Survey of Large Audio Language Models: Generalization, Trustworthiness, and Outlook
paper.abstract: The foundational capabilities established by Large Language Models (LLMs) have paved the way for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), within which Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) are essential for realizing universal auditory intelligence. Despite their remarkable performance, the escalation of LALMs' capabilities has significantly outpaced the development of systemic frameworks to ensure their trustworthiness. This survey provides a comprehensive investigation into the endogenous mecha

summary.core_problem: 系统梳理 Large Audio Language Models 的泛化能力、可信性风险，以及端到端音频语言模型带来的新安全面。
summary.importance: 贡献是综述和风险 taxonomy，不是新模型或新训练方法。对预训练研究员的价值在于快速了解 audio LM 的架构演进、对齐算法、连续声学信号带来的攻击面，以及 cross-modal jailbreaking、latent acoustic backdoor 等问题。
summary.technical_approach: 从 LALM 的内生机制出发，整理统一端到端框架、连续声学信号接入、架构创新和 alignment algorithm，并建立 trustworthiness taxonomy，覆盖跨模态越狱、潜在声学后门等漏洞类型。
summary.experiments: 作为 survey，摘要未显示新模型训练、系统实验或 benchmark 结果。重点应是分类框架、文献覆盖和风险定义，而不是性能数字。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息包括 Nanyang Technological University、The University of Melbourne、China Electric Power University、Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications；附加信息提到 Shanghai AI Laboratory、Tsinghua University、Tencent 参与。

summary_en.core_problem: The survey organizes the generalization and trustworthiness issues of Large Audio Language Models, especially the new risk surface introduced by end-to-end audio-language systems.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a taxonomy and literature synthesis rather than a new model or training method. For pretraining researchers, it is useful as a map of audio-LM architectures, alignment methods, and risks such as cross-modal jailbreaking and latent acoustic backdoors.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper analyzes LALMs through their internal mechanisms, covering unified end-to-end frameworks, continuous acoustic inputs, architectural choices, and alignment algorithms. It proposes a trustworthiness taxonomy for vulnerabilities including cross-modal jailbreaks and acoustic backdoors.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, the abstract does not report new training runs, benchmark construction, or empirical model comparisons. The useful content is likely the taxonomy, literature organization, and threat definitions.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed affiliations include Nanyang Technological University, The University of Melbourne, China Electric Power University, and Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications; the note also mentions Shanghai AI Laboratory, Tsinghua University, and Tencent.

recommendation.zh: 作为 audio LM 安全与架构索引可留档；别按研究结论读，重点扫 taxonomy 和参考文献表。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an index for audio-LM safety and architectures; do not read it as evidence, just scan the taxonomy and references.

paper.title: Deep Pre-Alignment for VLMs
paper.abstract: Most Vision Language Models (VLMs) directly map outputs from ViT encoders to the LLM via a lightweight projector. While effective, recent analysis suggests this architecture suffers from an alignment challenge: visual features remain distant from the text space in the initial layers of the LLM, forcing the model to waste critical depth~\cite{zhang-etal-2024-investigating,artzy-schwartz-2024-attend} on superficial modality alignment rather than deep understanding and complex reasoning. summary_en.core_problem: Existing VLM architectures connect ViT encoders to LLMs via lightweight projectors, leading to significant modality gaps between visual features and the LLM's text embedding space. This forces lower layers of the target LLM to allocate large capacity to shallow modality alignment instead of deep understanding and complex reasoning, and also triggers catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained language capabilities.
summary_en.importance: Provides a modular optimization approach for modality alignment in VLM pre-training, which can be implemented rapidly without modifying existing LLM training objectives or inference pipelines. It also validates the scalability of upstream alignment for performance gains in large-scale VLMs, and offers a new path to mitigate catastrophic forgetting in multimodal pre-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Deep Pre-Alignment (DPA) architecture, which replaces the standard ViT encoder with a small perceiver VLM module. The perceiver includes a ViT, a projector, and small LLM blocks, which progressively pre-align visual features to the target text space via its internal language layers, before feeding to the target LLM through a simple alignment projector. Training follows the standard two-stage VLM recipe: stage 1 only updates the alignment projector on image-caption data to fit dimension requirements; stage 2 performs end-to-end fine-tuning on high-quality visual instruction data.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on 8 multimodal benchmarks and 3 text benchmarks. Compared to the LLaVA baseline, average multimodal performance gains reach 1.9 points at 4B scale and 3.0 points at 32B scale, with gains scaling up with model size. Improvements are consistent across both Qwen3 and LLaMA 3.2 LLM backbones. Text performance degradation is reduced by 32.9% for 4B models and 21.6% for 32B models. The architecture only introduces 2% throughput loss for 32B models, with negligible additional overhead.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the introduction section's analysis of modality alignment overhead in VLM internal layers, and the experiment section's results on catastrophic forgetting mitigation and scalability testing. Expected reading time is 15 minutes. No need to dig into training details of the small perceiver VLM, focus on architectural design and ablation findings.

summary_en.importance: This work extends the GRPO algorithm to AR-Diffusion UMM training for the first time, verifying that advanced cognitive capabilities such as self-reflective refinement and reasoning text-to-image generation can be activated in pretrained UMMs without a cold-start stage, providing a new RL paradigm for post-training alignment of unified multimodal models. summary_en.technical_approach: The AlphaGRPO framework directly applies GRPO to pretrained UMMs without an additional cold-start SFT stage, formulating multimodal generation as a unified trajectory of "generate text first, then generate image", supporting two complex tasks: self-reflective refinement (autonomously diagnosing biases in initial generation and executing corrections) and reasoning text-to-image generation. paper.abstract: Training multimodal large language models has long been limited by the scarcity of high-quality paired multimodal data. Recent studies show that the shared representation space of pretrained multimodal contrastive models can serve as a bridge, enabling models to perform multimodal training with unimodal data. summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 CLIP/SigLIP 类共享表征空间中的 modality gap 到底是什么几何结构，并试图让单模态数据生成的替代表征可用于多模态大模型训练。
summary.importance: 它和 VLM 预训练直接相关。核心价值不在于又做了一个对齐模块，而在于把“用文本数据替代图文配对数据训练 MLLM”这个方向的关键假设拆开检查：图像和文本表征是否已经共享主语义几何，剩余差异是否能被可控校正。如果结论成立，文本-only 预训练或继续训练可以更安全地注入到视觉侧表示空间，缓解高质量图文对数据不足的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先做几何诊断。结论是：图像和文本表征并非两个无关分布。它们的协方差谱都有长尾衰减，主子空间重叠显著高于随机基线，说明对比学习已经建立了共享的主语义骨架。真正造成不可互换的不是简单的全局均值偏移。即使把文本表征平移到图像表征的质心，大部分跨模态差异仍然存在。残差也不是各向同性噪声，而是集中在少数主方向上的各向异性结构。基于这个观察，AnisoAlign 把共享空间分解为统计主导子空间和正交补空间，在主导子空间中用 blockwise polar parameterization 分离 radius 与 phase，以显式建模主方向上的结构变化。训练分两阶段：先只用目标模态样本预训练周期性 phase prior，学习目标模态内部的 phase 统计；再对源模态表征做有界残差校正，使其靠近目标模态支持集，同时尽量保留实例级语义结构。这个设计区别于简单 centroid shift 或直接学习跨模态映射，后两者要么校正能力不足，要么容易破坏语义邻域。
summary.experiments: 实验分为表征层和 MLLM 层。表征层结果显示，AnisoAlign 在匹配目标模态几何结构的同时更好保留源模态语义，能够降低主导各向异性残差，并改善局部 support compatibility。MLLM 层实验包括完全 text-only 训练，以及在视觉指令微调前加入 text-only 预训练。作者报告替代表征带来更好的下游表现，说明经过结构校正后的单模态表征可以部分承担图文配对监督的作用。提供的正文片段没有给出具体模型规模、数据规模和分数提升数字，因此关键定量结果需要查看实验表格后再判断强度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。重点看三处：第一，modality gap 的几何诊断，包括协方差谱、主子空间重叠、centroid shift 后的残差分析；第二，AnisoAlign 的 dominant subspace decomposition 和 blockwise polar parameterization，这决定了方法为何不是普通线性对齐；第三，MLLM text-only training / pretraining before visual instruction tuning 的实验设置。若时间有限，先看诊断图和 MLLM 结果表，再决定是否细读公式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what the modality gap in CLIP/SigLIP-style shared embedding spaces actually looks like, and whether unpaired unimodal data can be transformed into substitute representations for multimodal LLM training.
summary_en.importance: This is relevant to VLM pretraining because it addresses a practical bottleneck: high-quality paired image-text data is scarce, while text-only data is abundant. The useful part is the geometric analysis behind the alignment assumption. If image and text embeddings already share a dominant semantic structure, then the remaining mismatch may be corrected without paired supervision. That would make text-only pretraining a more plausible substitute or supplement for paired multimodal training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first diagnose the representation geometry. They find that image and text embeddings are not unrelated distributions: their covariance spectra have similar long-tail decay, and their principal subspaces overlap much more than random baselines. This suggests that contrastive pretraining has already built a shared dominant semantic backbone. The residual modality gap is not explained by a global centroid shift. After moving text embeddings to the image centroid, most of the discrepancy remains. Spectral analysis further shows that the residual is anisotropic, concentrated along a small number of dominant directions rather than spread as isotropic noise. AnisoAlign follows from this diagnosis. It decomposes the shared space into a dominant subspace and its orthogonal complement, then uses a blockwise polar parameterization inside the dominant subspace to model radius and phase structure. Training is staged: first, a periodic phase prior is learned from target-modality samples only; second, source-modality embeddings are corrected through bounded residual updates so that they move toward target-modality support while preserving instance-level semantics. This differs from simple mean shifting and from unconstrained cross-modal mapping, both of which can either under-correct the gap or damage semantic neighborhoods.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are organized at two levels. At the representation level, AnisoAlign is reported to better match target-modality geometry while preserving source semantics, reducing dominant anisotropic residual components and improving local support compatibility. At the MLLM level, the aligned substitute representations improve both fully text-only training and text-only pretraining before visual instruction tuning. The provided excerpt does not include exact model sizes, dataset sizes, or score deltas, so the quantitative strength of the claims should be checked against the experimental tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is appropriate. Prioritize the geometric diagnostics: covariance spectra, principal-subspace overlap, and residual analysis after centroid correction. Then read the dominant-subspace decomposition and blockwise polar parameterization, since these explain why the method is more structured than ordinary linear alignment. Finally, inspect the MLLM experiments on text-only training and text-only pretraining before visual instruction tuning.

recommendation.zh: 值得看表示几何部分；若结论成立，MLLM 用单模态数据补训练时不该再做粗暴全局对齐。
recommendation.en: Read the representation-geometry analysis; if it holds, unimodal-data MLLM training should avoid blunt global alignment.

paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at grounded reasoning but remain prone to object hallucination. Recent work treats self-generated captions as a uniformly positive resource, yet we find that naively embedding one can degrade rather than help--dropping Qwen2.5-VL-3B accuracy on HallusionBench by nearly 10 points. Two structural properties explain this. First, captions anchor not only the model's final answer but also its reasoning trajectory and lexical choices. Second, caption errors are asym

summary.core_problem: VLM 的幻觉缓解里，“给模型塞一段自生成 caption 当额外证据”看起来合理，但全文指出它会因为锚定效应（caption 会重塑推理轨迹与措辞）而在 caption 有错时放大伤害；同时 caption 的错误结构是强不对称的：遗漏多、捏造少，但捏造的单次代价更大。核心问题变成：能否在不训练、不开额外 caption 质量模型的情况下，对每个 query 自适应地决定 caption 应该影响模型多少，从而只吃到 caption 的增益、尽量规避其误导？
summary.importance: 这不是预训练论文，属于推理期的训练-free steering/融合策略；但对“训练信号质量与推理行为”的研究有两点启发：1）把 caption 当作一种外部 noisy teacher signal，强调其错误分布（omission vs fabrication）会决定最优融合策略，这个视角可迁移到合成数据/自训练数据的质量建模；2）用 logit-level 的可计算代理（置信度、信息增益、分歧惩罚）做动态门控，提供了一种低成本的 test-time mixture-of-experts/mixture-of-evidence 形式。对预训练的直接贡献有限，但对 VLM 可靠性与“外部证据注入”的方法论有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
GEASS（Gated Evidence-Aware Selective Steering）是一个 plug-and-play 的推理模块，不改模型参数：
- 双路径前向：同一问题跑两次解码/前向，一次不带 caption（clean path），一次带 caption（caption path），得到两套 logits。
- 三个信号控制 caption 影响强度（logit 融合权重/门控）：
  1）Confidence gate（Gated）：用 clean path 的最大概率/置信度衡量“模型是否需要外部帮助”。高置信度时倾向少用 caption，避免被锚定带偏。
  2）Information-gain weight（Evidence-Aware）：用 caption 引入后熵下降（entropy reduction）衡量 caption 是否真的提供了对当前 query 有用的信息，而不是只改变措辞。
  3）Disagreement penalty（Selective）：当两路径预测分歧大时，提高使用 caption 的门槛；编码“caption 更常遗漏、偶尔捏造但代价大”的先验——caption 更适合用来加强模型已有判断，而不适合强行推翻。
- 关键取舍：不去提升 caption 本身质量（避免更强 captioner/外部验证的额外成本），而是承认 caption 混合质量并在 logit 层面调制其锚定效应。代价是每个 query 额外两次前向（文中表述为 only two extra forward passes）。
summary.experiments:
全文在引言给了一个强对照：Qwen2.5-VL-3B 在 HallusionBench 上，直接嵌入自生成 caption 会把准确率从 61.19 降到 51.31（接近 10 点）。GEASS 的目标是在保留 caption 对“全局内容覆盖”的帮助时，避免这种系统性退化。
从摘录能确认：评测包含 HallusionBench，且提到也在 POPE 上验证；并强调训练-free、兼容标准解码。具体 GEASS 带来的提升幅度、在不同问题类型（全局 vs 细节）上的分层结果、以及三信号的消融贡献，需要看实验表格与分组分析部分才能给出精确数字。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看 Section 3（文中提到）关于 anchoring effect 与 error asymmetry 的实证分析：它解释了“为什么 caption 会害人”，比方法本身更可迁移。
- 再看 GEASS 的三信号定义与融合公式：尤其是 entropy reduction 的计算细节、以及 disagreement penalty 如何实现（阈值/温度/重加权）。
- 实验部分重点看：按问题类型分桶（global/detail）的结果、caption 错误类型统计（omission/fabrication）与性能相关性、以及消融（去掉 gate / IG / penalty 各自会怎样）。

summary_en.core_problem: Using self-generated captions as extra evidence is a common hallucination-mitigation trick for VLMs, but the paper shows it can significantly hurt because captions anchor not only the final answer but also the reasoning trajectory and lexical choices. Caption errors are also asymmetric: omissions are frequent, fabrications are rarer but far more damaging per instance. The problem is therefore per-query: how to decide, at inference time and without training, when and how strongly a caption should influence decoding so that it helps on global-coverage queries but does not mislead on detail-sensitive ones.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining paper; it is a training-free test-time steering method. Still, it offers transferable lessons for foundation-model research around noisy auxiliary signals: (1) treat captions as a noisy teacher/evidence source whose error distribution (omission vs fabrication) dictates the optimal fusion rule—an angle that also applies to synthetic data and self-training pipelines; (2) implement dynamic evidence gating via cheap, logit-level proxies (confidence, information gain, disagreement), resembling a test-time mixture-of-evidence mechanism. Direct impact on pretraining objectives is limited, but it informs reliability and evidence-injection design for VLM systems.
summary_en.technical_approach:
GEASS (Gated Evidence-Aware Selective Steering) is plug-and-play and parameter-free:
- Two-path inference: run the model with the original prompt (clean path) and with an appended self-caption (caption path), producing two logit streams.
- Logit-level modulation using three signals:
  1) Confidence gate: uses the clean-path max probability as a proxy for whether external evidence is needed.
  2) Evidence-aware weight: measures caption usefulness via entropy reduction induced by the caption (information gain proxy).
  3) Selective disagreement penalty: when the two paths disagree, raise the threshold for letting the caption override, encoding the prior that captions mostly omit and occasionally fabricate (high-cost).
- Design choice: do not improve caption quality (no stronger captioner or external verification); instead, control the anchoring effect by regulating caption influence at the logits. Overhead is two additional forward passes per query, compatible with standard decoding as long as logits are accessible.
summary_en.experiments:
A key motivating result is explicit: on HallusionBench, Qwen2.5-VL-3B drops from 61.19 to 51.31 accuracy when a self-generated caption is naively embedded, showing unconditional caption trust is harmful. GEASS is evaluated on HallusionBench and mentioned to be validated on POPE as well.
The excerpt does not include the final GEASS gains, per-category breakdowns (global vs detail questions), or ablations for the three signals; those numbers should be taken from the main experiment tables and grouped analyses.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Prioritize the analysis section (referred to as Section 3) that demonstrates anchoring effects and the omission/fabrication asymmetry; this is the most reusable part.
- Then read the GEASS formulation: exact definitions of entropy reduction, how disagreement is quantified, and the fusion rule.
- In experiments, focus on: stratified results by question type, caption error-type statistics, and ablations removing each of the three signals.

recommendation.en: Worth reading for the negative-caption analysis; it is a useful warning that generated captions are not free grounding signals and need query-level filtering.
